```{r setup, include=FALSE}
run_ei_only <- identical(Sys.getenv("GSE157504_RUN_EI"), "1")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  eval = !run_ei_only
)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, future.globals.maxSize = 20 * 1024^3)
set.seed(1313)

clock_display_map <- data.frame(
  author_original_id = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 6L, 7L, 8L, 9L, 12L, 14L, 15L, 18L, 19L, 20L, 25L, 29L),
  author_original_label = c(
    "1:DN1p_CNMa", "2:s_LNv", "3:DN1a", "4:DN1p", "5:LNd_Trissin", "6:DN1p",
    "7:DN1p", "8:LN_ITP", "9:LNd_NPF", "12:LNd", "14:DN3", "15:DN1p_CNMa",
    "18:DN1p", "19:DN2", "20:DN3", "25:l_LNv", "29:LPN"
  ),
  display_number = seq_len(17L),
  celltype = c(
    "DN1p_CNMa", "s_LNv", "DN1a", "DN1p", "LNd_Trissin", "DN1p", "DN1p",
    "LN_ITP", "LNd_NPF", "LNd", "DN3", "DN1p_CNMa", "DN1p", "DN2", "DN3",
    "l_LNv", "LPN"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
clock_display_map$display_label <- paste0(clock_display_map$display_number, ":", clock_display_map$celltype)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(clock_display_map$author_original_label), !anyDuplicated(clock_display_map$display_label))
```

Sections 1–6 run in the Seurat v4 environment. After the objects are saved, switch to the Seurat v5 environment and start again from Section 7. The plotting code reloads every object and does not depend on variables left in the v4 session.

All visible cell-class labels use **display IDs 1–17**, assigned by increasing original author cluster ID. The original author IDs remain unchanged in metadata, model strata and saved matrices; `clock_neuron_display_id_mapping.csv` records the auditable one-to-one mapping.


# 1. Input

```{r input}
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

if (packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  stop("Run Sections 1-6 in the Seurat v4 environment, then restart R for Section 7.")
}

project_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes"
package_dir <- "/path/to/scRhythmBayes"
data_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data/GSE157504_RAW")
validation_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "GSE157504_validation")
out_dir <- file.path(validation_dir, "result_LD_DD")
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
annotation_file <- file.path(
  validation_dir,
  "author_annotation_umap/reference/clock_neurons_annotation.csv"
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stopifnot(file.exists(annotation_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(package_dir, "R/infer_cell_phase.R")))
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(package_dir, "R/infer_gene_param.R")))

n_worker <- min(10L, max(1L, future::availableCores() - 2L))
```

# 2. GEO LD + DD counts and metadata

```{r read-geo}
raw_files <- sort(list.files(
  data_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
))

file_stem <- sub("\\.csv\\.gz$", "", basename(raw_files))

file_table <- tibble::tibble(
  file = raw_files,
  geo_sample = sub("_.*$", "", file_stem),
  sample = file_stem,
  condition = ifelse(grepl("_ZT[0-9]{2}_", file_stem), "LD", "DD"),
  time_type = sub(".*_([ZC]T)[0-9]{2}_.*", "\\1", file_stem),
  time_num = as.integer(sub(".*_[ZC]T([0-9]{2})_.*", "\\1", file_stem)),
  collection_date = sub(".*_[ZC]T[0-9]{2}_([0-9]{8})_.*", "\\1", file_stem),
  plate_id = sub(".*_(AR[0-9]+)$", "\\1", file_stem)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    batch = collection_date,
    time_label_raw = sprintf("%s%02d", time_type, time_num),
    time_author = sprintf("zt%02d", time_num),
    experiment = ifelse(condition == "LD", "CLK856_LD", "CLK856_DD"),
    integration_group = paste(experiment, time_author, sep = "_")
  )

stopifnot(nrow(file_table) == 84L)
stopifnot(sum(file_table$condition == "LD") == 36L)
stopifnot(sum(file_table$condition == "DD") == 48L)
stopifnot(identical(sort(unique(file_table$time_num)), c(2L, 6L, 10L, 14L, 18L, 22L)))

count_list <- lapply(raw_files, read.csv, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
count_list <- lapply(count_list, as.matrix)
count_list <- lapply(count_list, Matrix::Matrix, sparse = TRUE)

meta_list <- vector("list", length(count_list))

for (i in seq_along(count_list)) {
  meta_list[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    cell = colnames(count_list[[i]]),
    geo_sample = file_table$geo_sample[i],
    sample = file_table$sample[i],
    condition = file_table$condition[i],
    experiment = file_table$experiment[i],
    time_type = file_table$time_type[i],
    time_num = file_table$time_num[i],
    time_label_raw = file_table$time_label_raw[i],
    time_author = file_table$time_author[i],
    collection_date = file_table$collection_date[i],
    batch = file_table$batch[i],
    plate_id = file_table$plate_id[i],
    integration_group = file_table$integration_group[i]
  )
}

meta <- dplyr::bind_rows(meta_list)
count_raw <- Reduce(SeuratObject::RowMergeSparseMatrices, count_list)
count_raw <- as(count_raw, "dgCMatrix")

rm(count_list, meta_list)
gc()

meta <- meta[match(colnames(count_raw), meta$cell), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(count_raw)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(colnames(count_raw)))
stopifnot(identical(meta$cell, colnames(count_raw)))

dim(count_raw)
dplyr::count(file_table, condition, time_num)
```



# 3. Published quality control

```{r quality-control}
meta$nCount_RNA <- as.numeric(Matrix::colSums(count_raw))
meta$nFeature_RNA <- as.numeric(Matrix::colSums(count_raw > 0))

count_xlogx <- count_raw
count_xlogx@x <- count_xlogx@x * log(count_xlogx@x)
meta$entropy <- log(meta$nCount_RNA) - Matrix::colSums(count_xlogx) / meta$nCount_RNA

rm(count_xlogx)
gc()

meta$qc_pass <- with(
  meta,
  nCount_RNA > 6000 & nCount_RNA < 75000 &
    nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 &
    entropy > 5.5
)

qc_summary <- meta %>%
  dplyr::count(condition, time_num, time_label_raw, qc_pass, name = "n_cell") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(condition, time_num, dplyr::desc(qc_pass))

meta <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(qc_pass)
count_qc <- count_raw[, meta$cell, drop = FALSE]

rm(count_raw)
gc()

stopifnot(identical(meta$cell, colnames(count_qc)))

qc_report <- tibble::tibble(
  source = c("public_GEO_reconstruction", "paper_report"),
  n_qc_cell = c(nrow(meta), 4671L)
)

saveRDS(count_qc, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_qc_with_technical_features.rds"))
readr::write_csv(qc_summary, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_qc_summary.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_report, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_qc_cell_report.csv"))

qc_report
qc_summary
```

The current public GEO matrices yield 4,672 cells with the published thresholds, one more than the 4,671 reported in the paper. No cell is removed merely to force the published total.

# 4. Official author annotation

```{r author-annotation}
ann <- read.csv(
  annotation_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(c("experiment", "time", "Repeats", "Idents") %in% colnames(ann)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(ann)))

meta$canonical_cell <- sub("^X(?=[0-9]{8}_)", "", meta$cell, perl = TRUE)
meta$canonical_cell <- sub(
  "_(ZT|CT)([0-9]{2})_",
  "_zt\\2_",
  meta$canonical_cell,
  perl = TRUE
)

annotation_idx <- match(meta$canonical_cell, rownames(ann))
meta$author_experiment <- ann$experiment[annotation_idx]
meta$author_time <- ann$time[annotation_idx]
meta$author_repeat <- ann$Repeats[annotation_idx]
meta$author_cluster <- ann$Idents[annotation_idx]
meta$author_cluster_id <- sub(":.*$", "", meta$author_cluster)
meta$author_celltype <- sub("^[0-9]+:", "", meta$author_cluster)
meta$display_number <- clock_display_map$display_number[
  match(meta$author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
]
meta$display_label <- clock_display_map$display_label[
  match(meta$author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
]
meta$author_annotation_status <- ifelse(
  is.na(annotation_idx),
  "Unknown / not in author 17",
  "Author high-confidence 17"
)

author_levels <- unique(ann$Idents)
author_levels <- author_levels[order(as.integer(sub(":.*$", "", author_levels)))]
author_plot_levels <- c("Unknown / not in author 17", author_levels)
meta$author_cluster <- factor(meta$author_cluster, levels = author_levels)
meta$author_cluster_plot <- ifelse(
  is.na(meta$author_cluster),
  "Unknown / not in author 17",
  as.character(meta$author_cluster)
)
meta$author_cluster_plot <- factor(
  meta$author_cluster_plot,
  levels = author_plot_levels
)

repeat_map <- tibble::tibble(
  canonical_cell = rownames(ann),
  experiment = ann$experiment,
  time_author = ann$time,
  biological_repeat = ann$Repeats
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(collection_date = sub("_.*$", "", canonical_cell)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(experiment, time_author, collection_date, biological_repeat)

meta <- meta %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    repeat_map,
    by = c("experiment", "time_author", "collection_date")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    biological_sample = paste(
      condition,
      time_author,
      biological_repeat,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

annotated <- !is.na(meta$author_cluster)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(meta$canonical_cell))
stopifnot(sum(annotated) == 2615L)
stopifnot(setequal(meta$canonical_cell[annotated], rownames(ann)))
stopifnot(all(meta$author_experiment[annotated] == meta$experiment[annotated]))
stopifnot(all(meta$author_time[annotated] == meta$time_author[annotated]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(meta$biological_repeat))
stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(meta$biological_sample) == 24L)

annotation_report <- tibble::tibble(
  scope = c(
    "QC_all", "QC_LD", "QC_DD",
    "author_17_all", "author_17_LD", "author_17_DD",
    "unknown_all"
  ),
  n_cell = c(
    nrow(meta),
    sum(meta$condition == "LD"),
    sum(meta$condition == "DD"),
    sum(annotated),
    sum(annotated & meta$condition == "LD"),
    sum(annotated & meta$condition == "DD"),
    sum(!annotated)
  )
)

readr::write_csv(meta, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata_qc_annotated.csv"))
readr::write_csv(annotation_report, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_annotation_match_report.csv"))
readr::write_csv(clock_display_map, file.path(out_dir, "clock_neuron_display_id_mapping.csv"))

annotation_report
dplyr::count(meta, author_cluster, .drop = FALSE)
```

Only two barcode transformations are used: the leading `X` added by R is removed, and raw `_ZTxx_` or `_CTxx_` is converted to the authors' `_ztxx_`. Date, AR plate and terminal cell barcode are unchanged.

# 5. Author-aligned Seurat 3 integration sequence

```{r seurat-object}
meta <- as.data.frame(meta)
rownames(meta) <- meta$cell

seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = count_qc,
  meta.data = meta,
  project = "GSE157504_LD_DD"
)

seu$percent.mito <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^mt:")
seu$date <- factor(seu$collection_date)
seu$time.exper <- factor(paste(seu$time_author, seu$experiment, sep = ":"))
seu$integration_group <- factor(
  seu$integration_group,
  levels = c(
    paste0("CLK856_LD_zt", c("02", "06", "10", "14", "18", "22")),
    paste0("CLK856_DD_zt", c("02", "06", "10", "14", "18", "22"))
  )
)

genes_exclude <- unique(c(
  grep("^mt:", rownames(seu), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  grep("^rp[ls]", rownames(seu), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  grep("rRNA", rownames(seu), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  grep("tRNA", rownames(seu), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  grep("^ERCC", rownames(seu), value = TRUE),
  "EGFP"
))

length(genes_exclude)
table(seu$time.exper)
```

```{r sct-by-condition-time, message=TRUE}
seu_list <- SplitObject(seu, split.by = "time.exper")

for (i in seq_along(seu_list)) {
  message("SCTransform: ", names(seu_list)[i])
  seu_list[[i]] <- SCTransform(
    seu_list[[i]],
    assay = "RNA",
    vars.to.regress = c(
      "date", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mito"
    ),
    variable.features.n = 3000,
    return.only.var.genes = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  VariableFeatures(seu_list[[i]]) <- setdiff(
    VariableFeatures(seu_list[[i]]),
    genes_exclude
  )
}

hvg_each <- lapply(seu_list, VariableFeatures)
common_hvg <- Reduce(intersect, hvg_each)
common_hvg <- setdiff(common_hvg, genes_exclude)
common_gene <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  lapply(seu_list, function(x) rownames(x[["SCT"]]))
)

hvg_report <- tibble::tibble(
  time_experiment = names(seu_list),
  n_hvg_after_exclusion = lengths(hvg_each)
)

readr::write_lines(common_hvg, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_common_HVG.txt"))
readr::write_lines(common_gene, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_common_SCT_genes.txt"))
readr::write_csv(hvg_report, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_HVG_by_group.csv"))
saveRDS(seu_list, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_SCT_12groups_checkpoint.rds"))

length(common_hvg)
length(common_gene)
hvg_report
```

The 12 splits and exclusion set follow the authors' [`integrate.LD.DD.R`](https://github.com/rosbashlab/scRNA_seq_clock_neurons/blob/main/integrate.LD.DD.R) and [`f.cluster.seuratv3()`](https://github.com/rosbashlab/scRNA_seq_clock_neurons/blob/main/functions.main.R). The integration features are the variable genes shared by all 12 condition-time groups after exclusion of mitochondrial, ribosomal, rRNA, tRNA, ERCC and EGFP features.

```{r integration, message=TRUE}
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = seu_list,
  assay = rep("SCT", length(seu_list)),
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  reduction = "cca",
  anchor.features = common_hvg,
  dims = 1:50,
  k.anchor = 5,
  k.filter = 199,
  k.score = 30,
  verbose = TRUE
)

saveRDS(anchors, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_CCA_anchors_checkpoint.rds"))

seu_integrated <- IntegrateData(
  anchorset = anchors,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  dims = 1:50,
  k.weight = 100,
  features.to.integrate = common_gene,
  verbose = TRUE
)

DefaultAssay(seu_integrated) <- "integrated"
VariableFeatures(seu_integrated) <- common_hvg
seu_integrated <- ScaleData(
  seu_integrated,
  assay = "integrated",
  features = rownames(seu_integrated[["integrated"]]),
  verbose = TRUE
)

seu_integrated <- RunPCA(
  seu_integrated,
  assay = "integrated",
  npcs = 50,
  verbose = TRUE
)

seu_integrated <- FindNeighbors(
  seu_integrated,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:50,
  force.recalc = TRUE
)

seu_integrated <- FindClusters(
  seu_integrated,
  resolution = 1.0
)

meta_qc_all <- seu_integrated@meta.data
meta_qc_all <- meta_qc_all[match(colnames(seu_integrated), rownames(meta_qc_all)), , drop = FALSE]
meta_qc_all$recomputed_cluster_all <- factor(
  as.character(Idents(seu_integrated)),
  levels = as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(as.character(Idents(seu_integrated))))))
)

seu_integrated$recomputed_cluster_all <- meta_qc_all$recomputed_cluster_all
cells_author <- colnames(seu_integrated)[!is.na(seu_integrated$author_cluster)]

stopifnot(length(cells_author) == 2615L)

seu_author17 <- subset(seu_integrated, cells = cells_author)
DefaultAssay(seu_author17) <- "integrated"
seu_author17 <- RunPCA(
  seu_author17,
  assay = "integrated",
  npcs = 50,
  verbose = TRUE
)
seu_author17 <- RunUMAP(
  seu_author17,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:50,
  n.neighbors = 30,
  min.dist = 0.5,
  spread = 1,
  seed.use = 1313,
  umap.method = "uwot",
  metric = "cosine",
  reduction.name = "umap",
  reduction.key = "UMAP_",
  verbose = TRUE
)
seu_author17 <- FindNeighbors(
  seu_author17,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:50,
  force.recalc = TRUE
)
seu_author17 <- FindClusters(
  seu_author17,
  resolution = 1.0
)

seu_author17$recomputed_cluster <- factor(
  as.character(Idents(seu_author17)),
  levels = as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(as.character(Idents(seu_author17))))))
)
seu_author17$author_cluster_plot <- factor(
  as.character(seu_author17$author_cluster),
  levels = author_levels
)
seu_author17$condition <- factor(seu_author17$condition, levels = c("LD", "DD"))
seu_author17$time_label_raw <- factor(
  seu_author17$time_label_raw,
  levels = c(
    paste0("ZT", c("02", "06", "10", "14", "18", "22")),
    paste0("CT", c("02", "06", "10", "14", "18", "22"))
  )
)
seu_author17@misc$workflow_alignment <- list(
  author_repository_commit = "c8641b1354bd8c663c085cf05406050d6a6c2115",
  author_seurat_version = "3.0.2",
  local_seurat_version = as.character(packageVersion("Seurat")),
  display_reduction = "UMAP after author-17 subset",
  umap_min_dist = 0.5,
  umap_n_neighbors = 30L,
  umap_spread = 1,
  umap_seed = 1313L
)
Idents(seu_author17) <- "author_cluster"

stopifnot(ncol(seu_author17) == 2615L)
stopifnot(!anyNA(seu_author17$author_cluster))

meta_author17 <- seu_author17@meta.data
meta_author17 <- meta_author17[match(colnames(seu_author17), rownames(meta_author17)), , drop = FALSE]

cluster_summary_all <- dplyr::count(
  meta_qc_all,
  recomputed_cluster_all,
  name = "n_cell"
)
cluster_summary <- dplyr::count(
  meta_author17,
  recomputed_cluster,
  name = "n_cell"
)

rm(seu_integrated)
seu_integrated <- seu_author17
rm(seu_author17)

saveRDS(seu_integrated, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_Seurat_recomputed_UMAP.rds"))
saveRDS(seu_integrated, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_Seurat_author17_UMAP.rds"))
readr::write_csv(meta_qc_all, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata_all_with_recomputed_cluster.csv"))
readr::write_csv(meta_author17, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata_with_recomputed_cluster.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cluster_summary_all, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_recomputed_cluster_sizes_all.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cluster_summary, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_recomputed_cluster_sizes.csv"))

workflow_alignment <- tibble::tribble(
  ~step, ~author_implementation, ~local_implementation,
  "software", "Seurat 3.0.2", paste("Seurat", packageVersion("Seurat")),
  "author source", "GitHub repository", "commit c8641b1354bd8c663c085cf05406050d6a6c2115",
  "split", "time.exper: 6 times x LD/DD", "same 12 condition-time groups",
  "integration preparation", "PrepSCTIntegration commented out", "not run",
  "integration normalization", "Seurat 3.0.2 data-slot CCA; no normalization.method argument", "Seurat 4 LogNormalize compatibility branch on SCT assays",
  "features.to.integrate", "genes common to all SCT assays", "same",
  "post-integration scaling", "ScaleData on all integrated genes", "same",

  "cluster 14 label", "DN3 in integration script and official CSV", "14:DN3 from official per-cell CSV",
  "high-confidence subset", "17 clusters, then PCA/graph/clustering", "official barcode annotation, then same",
  "display reduction", "t-SNE", "UMAP: min.dist=0.5, n.neighbors=30, spread=1, seed=1313",
  "QC cell total", "4671 reported", "4672 reconstructed; no forced deletion"
)
readr::write_csv(

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
```

The authors used Seurat 3.0.2. Their source leaves `PrepSCTIntegration()` commented out, applies data-slot CCA integration to the SCT assays, integrates all genes common to the 12 SCT assays, and explicitly scales the integrated assay. Seurat 3.0.2 has no `normalization.method` argument in these integration functions. In Seurat 4.4.0, `normalization.method = "LogNormalize"` selects the compatible data-slot integration branch; it does not replace the preceding SCTransform with RNA LogNormalize. This is a compatibility implementation, not an identical Seurat 3 reproduction: package algorithms and defaults, including anchor-neighbor search, differ. De novo cluster numbering is never used to assign author labels.

Following the authors' [`subset_confident_clusters.R`](https://github.com/rosbashlab/scRNA_seq_clock_neurons/blob/main/subset_confident_clusters.R), PCA, the neighbor graph and Louvain clustering are recomputed after retaining the 2,615 high-confidence cells, and the active identities are then restored from the official annotation. UMAP is the one deliberate replacement for the authors' t-SNE. The same subset UMAP is used for the author-label and LD/DD panels.

The public subset script contains `14:DN1p`, whereas the authors' integration mapping and official per-cell annotation CSV both identify cluster 14 as `14:DN3`. The official CSV is used here; current de novo cluster numbers are not copied or relabeled as author identities.


# 6. Raw count and metadata objects

```{r standard-objects}
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

out_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/GSE157504_validation/result_LD_DD"
count_qc <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_qc_with_technical_features.rds"))
seu_integrated <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_Seurat_author17_UMAP.rds"))
meta_qc_all <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata_all_with_recomputed_cluster.csv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(collection_date = readr::col_character(), batch = readr::col_character(),
    date = readr::col_character(), author_cluster_id = readr::col_character(), time_num = readr::col_integer()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
author_levels <- levels(seu_integrated$author_cluster_plot)
stopifnot(length(author_levels) == 17L)
meta_qc_all$author_cluster <- factor(meta_qc_all$author_cluster, levels = author_levels)
meta_qc_all$author_cluster_plot <- factor(meta_qc_all$author_cluster_plot, levels = c("Unknown / not in author 17", author_levels))
meta_qc_all$recomputed_cluster_all <- factor(meta_qc_all$recomputed_cluster_all,
  levels = as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(meta_qc_all$recomputed_cluster_all)))))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(meta_qc_all$cell), setequal(colnames(count_qc), meta_qc_all$cell))

technical_gene <- grepl("^ERCC-", rownames(count_qc)) | rownames(count_qc) == "EGFP"
count_mat_all_qc <- count_qc[!technical_gene, , drop = FALSE]
count_mat_all_qc <- count_mat_all_qc[Matrix::rowSums(count_mat_all_qc) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
count_mat_all_qc <- Matrix::drop0(count_mat_all_qc)
meta_all_qc <- meta_qc_all[match(colnames(count_mat_all_qc), meta_qc_all$cell), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_all_qc), meta_all_qc$cell))

saveRDS(
  count_mat_all_qc,
  file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_raw_qc_all_with_unknown.rds")
)
readr::write_csv(
  meta_all_qc,
  file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata_all_with_unknown.csv")
)

meta <- meta_all_qc %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(author_cluster))
count_mat <- count_mat_all_qc[, meta$cell, drop = FALSE]
subset_cluster_idx <- match(meta$cell, colnames(seu_integrated))

stopifnot(!anyNA(subset_cluster_idx))

meta$recomputed_cluster <- seu_integrated$recomputed_cluster[subset_cluster_idx]

meta_LD <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "LD")
meta_DD <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "DD")
count_mat_LD <- count_mat[, meta_LD$cell, drop = FALSE]
count_mat_DD <- count_mat[, meta_DD$cell, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat), meta$cell))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_LD), meta_LD$cell))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_DD), meta_DD$cell))
stopifnot(ncol(count_mat) == 2615L)
stopifnot(!anyNA(meta$author_cluster))

saveRDS(count_mat, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_raw_qc.rds"))
saveRDS(count_mat_LD, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_count_raw_qc.rds"))
saveRDS(count_mat_DD, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_DD_count_raw_qc.rds"))
saveRDS(list(count = count_mat_LD, meta = meta_LD), file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_standard_object.rds"))
saveRDS(list(count = count_mat_DD, meta = meta_DD), file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_DD_standard_object.rds"))

readr::write_csv(meta, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata.csv"))
readr::write_csv(meta_LD, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_metadata.csv"))
readr::write_csv(meta_DD, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_DD_metadata.csv"))

tibble::tibble(
  object = c("LD", "DD"),
  n_gene = c(nrow(count_mat_LD), nrow(count_mat_DD)),
  n_cell = c(ncol(count_mat_LD), ncol(count_mat_DD)),
  n_author_17 = c(sum(!is.na(meta_LD$author_cluster)), sum(!is.na(meta_DD$author_cluster)))
)
```

The full 4,672-cell QC matrix and metadata are retained in files ending in `all_with_unknown`. The main raw-count and metadata objects contain only the 2,615 cells in the authors' 17 high-confidence clusters: 1,386 LD and 1,229 DD. The integrated assay is used only for PCA, clustering and UMAP. All scRhythmBayes analyses below use the filtered raw RNA count matrices.

Stop here, save the v4 session if needed, and switch to the Seurat v5 environment.

## 7.3 Marker GroupHeatmap

```{r author-marker-heatmap, fig.width=15.5, fig.height=12}
seu_integrated[["RNA"]] <- as(seu_integrated[["RNA"]], "Assay5")
seu_integrated <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(seu_integrated, assay = "RNA")

seu_author <- subset(seu_integrated, cells = cells_author)
seu_author$author_cluster_plot <- factor(
  as.character(seu_author$author_cluster_plot),
  levels = author_levels
)
seu_author$display_cluster <- factor(
  clock_display_map$display_label[
    match(as.character(seu_author$author_cluster_plot), clock_display_map$author_original_label)
  ],
  levels = display_levels
)

DefaultAssay(seu_author) <- "RNA"
seu_author <- NormalizeData(seu_author, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)
Idents(seu_author) <- "author_cluster_plot"

marker_all_path <- file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_author17_markers_all.csv")
marker_top_path <- file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_author17_markers_top2.csv")
if (file.exists(marker_all_path) && file.exists(marker_top_path)) {
  de_author <- readr::read_csv(marker_all_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  de_top <- readr::read_csv(marker_top_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  de_author <- FindAllMarkers(
    seu_author,
    assay = "RNA",
    slot = "data",
    only.pos = TRUE,
    min.pct = 0.20,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
    random.seed = 1313,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  de_top <- de_author %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      factor(as.character(cluster), levels = author_levels),
      dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC)
    )
}

de_top$author_original_label <- as.character(de_top$cluster)
de_top$display_cluster <- clock_display_map$display_label[

]
de_top$group1 <- factor(

)

marker_count <- dplyr::count(

)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(de_top$gene))

)
readr::write_csv(

)

marker_count
```

The marker heatmap tests whether each published label forms a coherent expression group with enriched positive markers. It supports annotation consistency but is not an independent ground-truth accuracy test.

# 8. LD first-run contract

```{r ld-contract}
package_dir <- "/path/to/scRhythmBayes"
out_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/GSE157504_validation/result_LD_DD"
n_worker <- min(10L, max(1L, future::availableCores() - 2L))

LD_object <- readRDS(
  file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_standard_object.rds")
)

count_mat_LD <- LD_object$count
meta_LD <- LD_object$meta

meta_LD_run <- meta_LD %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase_stratum = "LD_author17")

count_LD_run <- count_mat_LD[, meta_LD_run$cell, drop = FALSE]

ld_sample_check <- meta_LD_run %>%
  dplyr::distinct(time_num, biological_repeat, biological_sample) %>%
  dplyr::count(time_num, name = "n_independent_sample") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(time_num)

ld_celltype_sample_check <- meta_LD_run %>%
  dplyr::distinct(author_cluster, time_num, biological_sample) %>%
  dplyr::count(author_cluster, time_num, name = "n_independent_sample") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    author_cluster,
    time_num = c(2L, 6L, 10L, 14L, 18L, 22L),
    fill = list(n_independent_sample = 0L)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(author_cluster, time_num)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_LD_run), meta_LD_run$cell))
stopifnot(!anyNA(meta_LD_run$author_cluster))
stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(meta_LD_run$biological_sample) == 12L)
stopifnot(all(ld_sample_check$n_independent_sample == 2L))

readr::write_csv(ld_sample_check, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_sample_contract.csv"))
readr::write_csv(ld_celltype_sample_check, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_celltype_sample_coverage.csv"))

ld_sample_check
ld_celltype_sample_check
```

`biological_sample` is condition + sampling time + the authors' replicate label. AR plates are not used as biological replicates. The first run pools the official 17 clusters for stable phase estimation and sample-aware gene inference. Cell-type-specific fits should be added only after the coverage table is reviewed.

# 9. Cell phase

```{r cell-phase}
source(file.path(package_dir, "R/infer_cell_phase.R"))

fly_seedgene <- c(
  "per", "tim", "vri", "Pdp1", "Clk", "cwo"
)

stopifnot(all(fly_seedgene %in% rownames(count_LD_run)))

seed_check <- tibble::tibble(
  seedgene = fly_seedgene,
  detection_rate = as.numeric(
    Matrix::rowMeans(count_LD_run[fly_seedgene, , drop = FALSE] > 0)
  ),
  mean_count = as.numeric(
    Matrix::rowMeans(count_LD_run[fly_seedgene, , drop = FALSE])
  )
)

res_phase_LD <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = count_LD_run,
  metadata = meta_LD_run,
  ZT_by = "time_num",
  strata_by = "phase_stratum",
  seedgene = fly_seedgene,
  Species = "auto",
  min_seed = 0.01,
  family = "NB",
  Min_n = 200,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

stopifnot(identical(res_phase_LD$cell, meta_LD_run$cell))

saveRDS(res_phase_LD, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_author17_phase.rds"))
readr::write_csv(seed_check, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_author17_seed_check.csv"))
readr::write_csv(
  as.data.frame(attr(res_phase_LD, "seed_diagnostics")),
  file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_author17_seed_diagnostics.csv")
)

seed_check
head(res_phase_LD)
```

The fly seed panel is supplied explicitly; `Species = "auto"` does not select a built-in mouse or human panel. The seed genes are sanity checks and must be excluded from independent gene-level validation.

# 10. Phase validation

```{r phase-validation}
phase_LD <- meta_LD_run %>%
  dplyr::select(
    cell, author_cluster, author_celltype,
    time_num, time_label_raw,
    biological_repeat, biological_sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(as.data.frame(res_phase_LD), by = "cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phase_error_hours = abs(ZT_pred - time_num),
    phase_error_hours = pmin(phase_error_hours, 24 - phase_error_hours),
    ZT_pred_unwrapped = time_num + ((ZT_pred - time_num + 12) %% 24 - 12)
  )

phase_by_sample <- phase_LD %>%
  dplyr::group_by(biological_sample, biological_repeat, time_num) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cell = dplyr::n(),
    theta_pred = atan2(mean(sin(theta_pred)), mean(cos(theta_pred))) %% (2 * pi),
    ZT_pred = theta_pred * 24 / (2 * pi),
    mean_r_cell = mean(r_cell),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phase_error_hours = abs(ZT_pred - time_num),
    phase_error_hours = pmin(phase_error_hours, 24 - phase_error_hours)
  )

phase_accuracy <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  phase_LD %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      unit = "cell",
      n = dplyr::n(),
      mean_error_hours = mean(phase_error_hours),
      median_error_hours = median(phase_error_hours),
      within_2h = mean(phase_error_hours <= 2),
      within_4h = mean(phase_error_hours <= 4),
      mean_r_cell = mean(r_cell)
    ),
  phase_by_sample %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      unit = "biological_sample",
      n = dplyr::n(),
      mean_error_hours = mean(phase_error_hours),
      median_error_hours = median(phase_error_hours),
      within_2h = mean(phase_error_hours <= 2),
      within_4h = mean(phase_error_hours <= 4),
      mean_r_cell = mean(mean_r_cell)
    )
)

readr::write_csv(phase_LD, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_author17_phase_by_cell.csv"))
readr::write_csv(phase_by_sample, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_author17_phase_by_sample.csv"))
readr::write_csv(phase_accuracy, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_author17_phase_accuracy.csv"))

phase_accuracy
phase_by_sample
```

# 11. Gene parameters

```{r gene-parameter}
source(file.path(package_dir, "R/infer_gene_param.R"))

phase_idx <- match(meta_LD_run$cell, res_phase_LD$cell)
stopifnot(!anyNA(phase_idx))

res_param_LD <- infer_gene_param(
  count = count_LD_run,
  metadata = meta_LD_run,
  theta_pred = res_phase_LD$theta_pred[phase_idx],
  r_cell = res_phase_LD$r_cell[phase_idx],
  strata_by = "phase_stratum",
  ZT_by = "time_num",
  B = 100,
  n_worker = n_worker,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE,
  sample_by = "biological_sample",
  sample_boot_by = "time_num"
)

saveRDS(res_param_LD, file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_author17_gene_param.rds"))

param_long_LD <- res_param_LD$param_long

gene_summary_LD <- param_long_LD %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_gene = dplyr::n_distinct(gene),
```

LD and DD are inferred separately with the same six fly seed genes and the same settings. Their phase origins are anchored to the sampling-time prior within each condition. Cross-condition panels therefore describe relative organization and fitted expression against each condition-specific reference; they are not an independent proof of an absolute LD-to-DD phase shift.

## 12.1 Inferred phase versus sample time

```{r phase-scatter-display, eval=TRUE, fig.width=5.6, fig.height=5.3}
phase_figure_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "individual_figures_20261013")
dir.create(phase_figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

phase_cell_plot_data <- phase_meta %>%
  dplyr::mutate(inferred_hour = (theta_pred %% (2 * pi)) * 24 / (2 * pi))
phase_sample_plot_data <- phase_cell_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition, time_num, biological_sample, biological_repeat) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    theta_pred = atan2(mean(sin(theta_pred)), mean(cos(theta_pred))) %% (2 * pi),
    inferred_hour = theta_pred * 24 / (2 * pi),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phase_correlation <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  phase_cell_plot_data %>% dplyr::mutate(unit = "cell"),
  phase_sample_plot_data %>% dplyr::mutate(unit = "biological sample")
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(unit, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    pearson_r = stats::cor(time_num, inferred_hour, method = "pearson"),
    circular_r = {
      known_angle <- 2 * pi * time_num / 24
      inferred_angle <- 2 * pi * inferred_hour / 24
      known_center <- atan2(mean(sin(known_angle)), mean(cos(known_angle)))
      inferred_center <- atan2(mean(sin(inferred_angle)), mean(cos(inferred_angle)))
      sum(sin(known_angle - known_center) * sin(inferred_angle - inferred_center)) /
        sqrt(sum(sin(known_angle - known_center)^2) * sum(sin(inferred_angle - inferred_center)^2))
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

make_phase_scatter <- function(plot_data, condition_now, unit_now) {
  stat_now <- phase_correlation %>%
    dplyr::filter(condition == condition_now, unit == unit_now)
  is_cell <- identical(unit_now, "cell")
  caption_now <- if (condition_now == "DD") {
    "DD uses CT; the x-axis is shown as ZT.\nPearson r is linear; 0/24 wrapping affects it."
  } else {
    "Pearson r is linear; 0/24 wrapping affects it."
  }

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data %>% dplyr::filter(condition == condition_now),
    ggplot2::aes(x = time_num, y = inferred_hour)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(
      intercept = 0, slope = 1, linewidth = 0.75,
      linetype = "dashed", colour = "#777777"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      size = if (is_cell) 3.0 else 5.2,
      stroke = if (is_cell) 0.65 else 1.05,
      alpha = if (is_cell) 0.32 else 0.88,
      colour = c(LD = "#548E72", DD = "#8A70A5")[[condition_now]],
      fill = c(LD = "#D8EADE", DD = "#D5CAE3")[[condition_now]],
      position = if (is_cell) ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.14, height = 0) else "identity"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.8, 24.8), breaks = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.8, 24.8), breaks = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = condition_now,
      subtitle = paste0("Pearson r = ", formatC(stat_now$pearson_r, format = "f", digits = 2)),
      x = "ZT", y = "Inferred phase (h)", caption = caption_now
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 29, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 5)),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5, hjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 8)),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#222222"),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(9, 12, 9, 10)
    )
}

phase_cell_plots <- list(
  LD = make_phase_scatter(phase_cell_plot_data, "LD", "cell"),
  DD = make_phase_scatter(phase_cell_plot_data, "DD", "cell")
)
phase_sample_plots <- list(
  LD = make_phase_scatter(phase_sample_plot_data, "LD", "biological sample"),
  DD = make_phase_scatter(phase_sample_plot_data, "DD", "biological sample")
)

for (condition_now in c("LD", "DD")) {
```

# 13. Panel E: cell-phase density ridgeline

```{r panel-e, eval=TRUE, fig.width=9.2, fig.height=13.2}
ridge_data <- list()

for (celltype in author_levels) {
  for (condition_now in c("LD", "DD")) {
    theta_use <- phase_meta$theta_pred[
      phase_meta$author_cluster == celltype &
        phase_meta$condition == condition_now
    ]
    d <- stats::density(
      c(theta_use - 2 * pi, theta_use, theta_use + 2 * pi),
      bw = 0.35, from = 0, to = 2 * pi, n = 720
    )
    ridge_data[[length(ridge_data) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
      author_cluster = celltype,
      display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
        match(celltype, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
      ],
      condition = condition_now,
      theta = d$x,
      density = 3 * d$y,
      ridge_height = d$y / max(d$y),
      baseline = match(celltype, rev(author_levels))
    )
  }
}

ridge_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(ridge_data)
```

# 14. Panel F: CellAlign LD versus DD trajectories

```{r panel-f, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE}
library(cellAlign)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

source(file.path(
  validation_dir,
  "../scHeart_by_celltype/plotAlignCustom-copy.R"
))

stopifnot(identical(rownames(count_LD_run), rownames(count_DD_run)))

lib_size <- Matrix::colSums(count_all)
expr_all <- count_all %*% Matrix::Diagonal(x = 10000 / lib_size)
expr_all@x <- log1p(expr_all@x)
dimnames(expr_all) <- dimnames(count_all)

theta_all <- stats::setNames(phase_all$theta_pred, phase_all$cell)
cellalign_genes <- c(
  "per", "tim", "vri", "Pdp1", "Clk", "cwo",
  "CrebA", "pdm3", "DIP-beta", "dpr8", "beat-Ic", "beat-Va"
)
cellalign_genes <- intersect(cellalign_genes, rownames(expr_all))

alignment_list <- vector("list", length(author_levels))
alignment_grob <- vector("list", length(author_levels))
alignment_summary <- vector("list", length(author_levels))

for (i in seq_along(author_levels)) {
  celltype_use <- author_levels[i]
  display_use <- clock_display_map$display_label[
    match(celltype_use, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
  ]
  celltype_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", celltype_use)
  cells_LD <- meta_all$cell[
    meta_all$author_cluster == celltype_use & meta_all$condition == "LD"
  ]
  cells_DD <- meta_all$cell[
    meta_all$author_cluster == celltype_use & meta_all$condition == "DD"
  ]

  detect_LD <- Matrix::rowMeans(count_all[cellalign_genes, cells_LD, drop = FALSE] > 0)
  detect_DD <- Matrix::rowMeans(count_all[cellalign_genes, cells_DD, drop = FALSE] > 0)
  gene_use <- cellalign_genes[detect_LD >= 0.05 & detect_DD >= 0.05]

  stopifnot(length(gene_use) >= 3L)

  inter_LD <- cellAlign::interWeights(
    expDataBatch = as.matrix(expr_all[gene_use, cells_LD, drop = FALSE]),
    trajCond = theta_all[cells_LD],
    winSz = 0.1,
    numPts = 30
  )
  inter_DD <- cellAlign::interWeights(
    expDataBatch = as.matrix(expr_all[gene_use, cells_DD, drop = FALSE]),
    trajCond = theta_all[cells_DD],
    winSz = 0.1,
    numPts = 30
  )

  scaled_LD <- cellAlign::scaleInterpolate(inter_LD)
  scaled_DD <- cellAlign::scaleInterpolate(inter_DD)

  alignment <- cellAlign::globalAlign(
    x = scaled_DD$scaledData[gene_use, , drop = FALSE],
    y = scaled_LD$scaledData[gene_use, , drop = FALSE],
    scores = list(query = scaled_DD$traj, ref = scaled_LD$traj),
    sigCalc = TRUE,
    numPerm = 20
  )

  alignment_list[[i]] <- alignment
  alignment_summary[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    author_cluster = celltype_use,
    display_cluster = display_use,
    n_LD = length(cells_LD),
    n_DD = length(cells_DD),
    n_gene = length(gene_use),
    genes = paste(gene_use, collapse = ";"),
    distance = alignment$distance,
    normalized_distance = alignment$normalizedDistance,
    module_normalized_distance = alignment$normDistModule
  )

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    file.path(panel_dir, paste0("Panel_F_CellAlign_", celltype_tag, ".pdf")),
    width = 3.6,
    height = 3.6
  )
  plotAlignCustom(
    alignment = alignment,
    title = display_use,
    ref_name = "LD",
    query_name = "DD"
  )
  grDevices::dev.off()

  ragg::agg_png(
    file.path(panel_dir, paste0("Panel_F_CellAlign_", celltype_tag, ".png")),
    width = 3.6,
    height = 3.6,
    units = "in",
    res = 600,
    background = "white"
  )
  plotAlignCustom(
    alignment = alignment,
    title = display_use,
    ref_name = "LD",
    query_name = "DD"
  )
  grDevices::dev.off()

  alignment_grob[[i]] <- grid::grid.grabExpr(
    plotAlignCustom(
      alignment = alignment,
      title = display_use,
      ref_name = "LD",
      query_name = "DD"
    ),
    wrap = TRUE
  )
}

names(alignment_list) <- author_levels
alignment_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(alignment_summary)
panel_F_grid <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(grobs = alignment_grob, ncol = 4)

grDevices::cairo_pdf(
  file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_F_CellAlign_all_celltypes.pdf"),
  width = 13.5,
  height = 18
)

alignment_summary
```

Panel F uses raw-count-derived log-normalized expression, not the integrated assay. DD is the CellAlign query and LD is the reference. The gene set contains the six phase seeds plus published fly non-seed examples, so this trajectory alignment is descriptive and not an independent validation of phase inference.

The default refresh below redraws the saved CellAlign results with display IDs and never recomputes the alignments. Set the analysis chunk above to `eval=TRUE` only for an explicitly authorized full CellAlign rerun.


# 15. Panel G: 24-bin DTW similarity

```{r panel-g, eval=TRUE, message=TRUE}

circular_distance_path_G <- file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_G_circular_shift_sensitivity_distance.tsv")
best_shift_path_G <- file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_G_circular_shift_best_bin.tsv")
if (!file.exists(circular_distance_path_G) || !file.exists(best_shift_path_G)) {
  hist_wide_G <- dtw_res$histogram %>%
    dplyr::select(combo, bin, prop) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = bin, values_from = prop)
  hist_mat_G <- as.matrix(hist_wide_G[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(hist_mat_G) <- hist_wide_G$combo
  circular_distance_G <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(hist_mat_G), ncol = nrow(hist_mat_G), dimnames = list(rownames(hist_mat_G), rownames(hist_mat_G)))
  best_shift_G <- circular_distance_G

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(hist_mat_G))) {
    if (i < nrow(hist_mat_G)) {
      for (j in seq.int(i + 1L, nrow(hist_mat_G))) {
        shift_distance <- numeric(ncol(hist_mat_G))
        for (s in 0:(ncol(hist_mat_G) - 1L)) {
          idx_shift <- ((seq_len(ncol(hist_mat_G)) + s - 1L) %% ncol(hist_mat_G)) + 1L
          fit_shift <- dtw::dtw(hist_mat_G[i, ], hist_mat_G[j, idx_shift], keep = TRUE)
          shift_distance[s + 1L] <- fit_shift$distance / length(fit_shift$index1)
        }
        circular_distance_G[i, j] <- min(shift_distance)
        circular_distance_G[j, i] <- circular_distance_G[i, j]
        best_shift_G[i, j] <- which.min(shift_distance) - 1L
        best_shift_G[j, i] <- best_shift_G[i, j]
      }
    }
  }
  write.table(circular_distance_G, circular_distance_path_G, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)
  write.table(best_shift_G, best_shift_path_G, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)
}

dtw_res$combo
```

Panel G follows the heart Rmd and the current project functions: 24 circular bins, path-length-normalized `dtw::dtw` distance, then within-matrix min-max similarity. The similarity is relative to this matrix and must not be compared numerically across separate analyses. Standard linear DTW does not make the first and last bin adjacent; the circular-shift sensitivity matrices are saved as an audit and are not substituted for the reference-style panel.

# 16. Panel H: biological-sample rho

```{r panel-h, eval=TRUE, fig.width=11.8, fig.height=7.6}
source(file.path(package_dir, "R/run_phase_rho.R"))

rho_result_path <- file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_H_rho_result.rds")
if (file.exists(rho_result_path)) {
  rho_res <- readRDS(rho_result_path)
} else {
  rho_res <- run_phase_rho(
    res_phase = as.data.frame(phase_all),
    metadata = as.data.frame(meta_all),
    celltype_by = "author_cluster",
    group_by = "condition",
    sample_by = "biological_sample",
    theta_by = "theta_pred",
    celltype_levels = author_levels,
    group_levels = c("LD", "DD"),
    compare_groups = c("LD", "DD"),
    min_cell = 3,
    p_adjust_method = "BH",
    Verbose = TRUE
  )
}

rho_sample_H <- rho_res$rho_sample %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rho_percent = 100 * rho,
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(cell_type, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_all %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        biological_sample, condition,
        time_num, biological_repeat
      ),
    by = c("Sample" = "biological_sample", "Group" = "condition")
  )

sig_H <- rho_res$sig_result %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(cell_type, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ],
    eligible = n_group1 >= 5 & n_group2 >= 5,
    p_adj = NA_real_
  )
sig_H$p_adj[sig_H$eligible] <- stats::p.adjust(
  sig_H$p_value[sig_H$eligible],
  method = "BH"
)
sig_H <- sig_H %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(
      !eligible ~ "",
      p_adj < 1e-4 ~ "****",
      p_adj < 1e-3 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 1e-2 ~ "**",
      p_adj < 5e-2 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    y_pos = 103
  )

celltype_order_H <- rho_sample_H %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(rho_mean = mean(rho), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rho_mean)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(cell_type) %>%
  as.character()
display_order_H <- clock_display_map$display_label[
  match(celltype_order_H, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
]

rho_sample_H <- rho_sample_H %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
    cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = celltype_order_H),
    display_cluster = factor(display_cluster, levels = display_order_H)
  )
sig_H$cell_type <- factor(sig_H$cell_type, levels = celltype_order_H)
sig_H$display_cluster <- factor(sig_H$display_cluster, levels = display_order_H)

p_H <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rho_sample_H,
  ggplot2::aes(x = display_cluster, y = rho_percent, fill = Group)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    width = 0.56,
    linewidth = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    colour = "black",
    shape = 16,
    position = ggplot2::position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.08,
      dodge.width = 0.72
    ),
    size = 1.35,
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = sig_H,
    ggplot2::aes(x = display_cluster, y = y_pos, label = p_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_pal,
    breaks = c("LD", "DD"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 105),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "rho (%)") +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_H_sample_level_rho.pdf"), p_H, width = 11.8, height = 7.6, bg = "white")
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_H_sample_level_rho.png"), p_H, width = 11.8, height = 7.6, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

readr::write_csv(rho_sample_H, file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_H_sample_level_rho.csv"))
rho_summary_H <- rho_res$rho_sample_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(cell_type, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  )
readr::write_csv(rho_summary_H, file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_H_sample_level_rho_summary.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sig_H, file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_H_wilcoxon_BH.csv"))
saveRDS(rho_res, file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_H_rho_result.rds"))

p_H
```

The unit in Panel H is the author's independent biological sample: condition + sampling time + author repeat. AR plates are technical partitions within those samples. Rho is shown only when a sample contributes at least three cells to that cell type; Wilcoxon rank-sum tests are reported only when both conditions retain at least five biological samples, with BH correction across eligible cell types. Each rho is within one sampling time, whereas the group comparison pools the six sampling times and is exploratory.

Panel I uses five published, non-seed fly examples in their reported author clusters: `CrebA`, `DIP-beta` and `beat-Ic` in `2:s_LNv`, and `pdm3` and `beat-Va` in `1:DN1p_CNMa`. The curves are generated from LD and DD fits using the real biological samples. No module label is shown because a fly rhythm-module result has not been run, and genes were selected from the paper rather than by significance in this dataset.

# 20. Biological validation from saved outputs only

This section starts from the saved raw-count, metadata, phase and Panel I gene-parameter objects. It does not call `infer_cell_phase()`, `infer_gene_param()`, `infer_rhythm_module()` or rerun Seurat integration. All time-course panels below are labelled as observed expression unless they explicitly read an existing saved fit.

```{r biological-validation-input, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE}
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

validation_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/GSE157504_validation"
out_dir <- file.path(validation_dir, "result_LD_DD")
panel_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "panels_EI")
validation_plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "biological_validation")
validation_qa_dir <- file.path(validation_plot_dir, "qa")

dir.create(validation_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(validation_qa_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

group_pal <- c("LD" = "#D8EADE", "DD" = "#D5CAE3")
condition_line_pal <- c("LD" = "#548E72", "DD" = "#8A70A5")
clock_display_map <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "clock_neuron_display_id_mapping.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

validation_files <- tibble::tribble(
  ~object, ~path, ~required,
  "author-17 raw RNA counts", file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_raw_qc.rds"), TRUE,
  "author-17 metadata", file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata.csv"), TRUE,
  "per-cell phase", file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_author17_phase.rds"), TRUE,
  "Panel I gene selection", file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_I_gene_selection.csv"), TRUE,
  "Panel I gene parameters", file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_I_selected_gene_param.rds"), TRUE,
  "Panel I fitted curves", file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_I_fitted_curves.csv"), TRUE,
  "author annotation", file.path(validation_dir, "author_annotation_umap/reference/clock_neurons_annotation.csv"), TRUE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(exists = file.exists(path))

stopifnot(all(validation_files$exists[validation_files$required]))

count_validation <- readRDS(validation_files$path[validation_files$object == "author-17 raw RNA counts"])
meta_validation <- readr::read_csv(
  validation_files$path[validation_files$object == "author-17 metadata"],
  col_types = readr::cols(
    collection_date = readr::col_character(),
    batch = readr::col_character(),
    date = readr::col_character(),
    author_cluster_id = readr::col_character(),
    time_num = readr::col_integer()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  )
phase_validation <- readRDS(validation_files$path[validation_files$object == "per-cell phase"])
gene_panel_I_saved <- readr::read_csv(
  validation_files$path[validation_files$object == "Panel I gene selection"],
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
param_I_saved <- readRDS(validation_files$path[validation_files$object == "Panel I gene parameters"])

required_meta_columns <- c(
  "cell", "condition", "time_type", "time_num", "author_cluster",
  "biological_repeat", "biological_sample", "plate_id"
)

stopifnot(
  inherits(count_validation, "dgCMatrix"),
  all(required_meta_columns %in% names(meta_validation)),
  identical(colnames(count_validation), meta_validation$cell),
  !anyNA(meta_validation$author_cluster),
  !any(grepl("Unknown", meta_validation$author_cluster, ignore.case = TRUE)),
  setequal(phase_validation$cell, meta_validation$cell),
  all(c("theta_pred", "r_cell") %in% names(phase_validation)),
  all(c("param_long", "fit_diagnostics", "bootstrap_res") %in% names(param_I_saved))
)

supplement_candidates <- list.files(
  validation_dir,
  pattern = "supplement|supp[_ -]*file[_ -]*1|rhythmic[_ -]*gene",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

validation_files <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  validation_files,
  tibble::tibble(
    object = "original paper Supplementary file 1",
    path = if (length(supplement_candidates) == 0L) NA_character_ else supplement_candidates[1],
    required = FALSE,
    exists = length(supplement_candidates) > 0L
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    use = dplyr::case_when(
      object == "original paper Supplementary file 1" & !exists ~ "not used; no local file found",
      exists ~ "read saved output",
      TRUE ~ "not used"
    )
  )

readr::write_csv(
  validation_files,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "biological_validation_input_audit.csv")
)

validation_files
```

# 21. Author-cluster sample coverage

```{r biological-validation-coverage, eval=TRUE, fig.width=13.2, fig.height=5}
author_levels_validation <- unique(as.character(meta_validation$author_cluster))
author_levels_validation <- author_levels_validation[
  order(as.integer(sub(":.*$", "", author_levels_validation)))
]
display_levels_validation <- clock_display_map$display_label[
  match(author_levels_validation, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
]

sample_reference_validation <- meta_validation %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    condition, time_type, time_num,
    biological_repeat, biological_sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(condition, time_num, biological_repeat)

coverage_by_sample <- meta_validation %>%
  dplyr::count(
    author_cluster, condition, time_type, time_num,
    biological_repeat, biological_sample,
    name = "n_cells"
  )

coverage_by_sample <- tidyr::crossing(
  author_cluster = author_levels_validation,
  sample_reference_validation
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    coverage_by_sample,
    by = c(
      "author_cluster", "condition", "time_type", "time_num",
      "biological_repeat", "biological_sample"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_cells = tidyr::replace_na(n_cells, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(author_cluster, condition, time_num, biological_repeat)

coverage_by_time <- coverage_by_sample %>%
  dplyr::group_by(author_cluster, condition, time_type, time_num) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_biological_samples_expected = dplyr::n(),
    n_biological_samples_with_cells = sum(n_cells > 0),
    min_cells_per_represented_sample = if (any(n_cells > 0)) min(n_cells[n_cells > 0]) else 0L,
    max_cells_per_represented_sample = if (any(n_cells > 0)) max(n_cells[n_cells > 0]) else 0L,
    n_cells = sum(n_cells),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

coverage_interpretation <- coverage_by_time %>%
  dplyr::group_by(author_cluster, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_timepoints_expected = 6L,
    n_timepoints_with_cells = sum(n_cells > 0),
    n_timepoints_with_two_replicates = sum(n_biological_samples_with_cells >= 2),
    min_replicates_per_time = min(n_biological_samples_with_cells),
    min_cells_per_represented_sample = min(
      min_cells_per_represented_sample[min_cells_per_represented_sample > 0],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    min_cells_per_represented_sample = dplyr::if_else(
      is.infinite(min_cells_per_represented_sample),
      0,
      min_cells_per_represented_sample
    ),
    interpretation = dplyr::case_when(
      n_timepoints_with_cells == 6L & min_replicates_per_time >= 2L ~
        "six-time descriptive trajectory with two represented biological replicates per time",
      n_timepoints_with_cells == 6L ~
        "six-time descriptive trajectory; at least one time has fewer than two represented biological replicates",
      TRUE ~
        "incomplete six-time coverage; restrict interpretation to observed samples"
    )
  )

readr::write_csv(
  coverage_by_sample,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "author17_coverage_by_biological_sample.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  coverage_by_time,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "author17_coverage_by_condition_time.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  coverage_interpretation,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "author17_coverage_interpretation.csv")
)

coverage_plot_data <- coverage_by_time %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(as.character(author_cluster), clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    author_cluster = factor(author_cluster, levels = rev(author_levels_validation)),
    display_cluster = factor(display_cluster, levels = rev(display_levels_validation)),
    tile_label = paste0(n_cells, " cells\nn=", n_biological_samples_with_cells)
  )

coverage_main_levels <- c("19:DN2", "2:s_LNv", "1:DN1p_CNMa")
coverage_main_display <- clock_display_map$display_label[
  match(coverage_main_levels, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
]
coverage_main_data <- coverage_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(author_cluster %in% coverage_main_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    author_cluster = factor(as.character(author_cluster), levels = rev(coverage_main_levels)),
    display_cluster = factor(as.character(display_cluster), levels = rev(coverage_main_display))
  )

make_coverage_panel <- function(plot_data, condition_name, tile_text_size, y_text_size) {
  plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(condition == condition_name) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = time_num, y = display_cluster)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(
      fill = c(LD = "#E8F2EC", DD = "#EEEAF3")[[condition_name]],
      colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(label = tile_label),
      size = tile_text_size, lineheight = 1.05,
      colour = "#242424", fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22),
      labels = sprintf("%02d", c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = if (condition_name == "DD") "DD (CT samples)" else "LD",
      x = "ZT", y = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14.5, colour = "#242424"),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_text_size, face = "bold", colour = "#242424"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 26, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 14, 8, 10)
    )
}

p_L_main <- (
```

# 22. Observed pseudobulk expression trajectories

```{r biological-validation-pseudobulk, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE}
dn2_gene_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~gene, ~author_cluster, ~validation_role, ~seed_independent_reference,
  "tim", "19:DN2", "DN2 phase-seed reproduction", FALSE,
  "vri", "19:DN2", "DN2 phase-seed reproduction", FALSE,
  "per", "19:DN2", "DN2 positive-control supplement", FALSE
)

reference_gene_map <- gene_panel_I_saved %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    validation_role = "published non-seed Panel I reference",
    seed_independent_reference = TRUE
  )

validation_gene_map <- dplyr::bind_rows(dn2_gene_map, reference_gene_map) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  )

stopifnot(
  all(validation_gene_map$gene %in% rownames(count_validation)),
  all(validation_gene_map$author_cluster %in% meta_validation$author_cluster),
  !any(validation_gene_map$gene[validation_gene_map$validation_role == "published non-seed Panel I reference"] %in% c("per", "tim", "vri", "Pdp1", "Clk", "cwo"))
)

meta_pb <- meta_validation %>%
  dplyr::filter(author_cluster %in% unique(validation_gene_map$author_cluster)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster_sample = paste(author_cluster, biological_sample, sep = " || ")
  )

cluster_sample_levels <- unique(meta_pb$cluster_sample)
cluster_sample_factor <- factor(meta_pb$cluster_sample, levels = cluster_sample_levels)
pb_design <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + cluster_sample_factor)
colnames(pb_design) <- cluster_sample_levels

pb_counts <- count_validation[, meta_pb$cell, drop = FALSE] %*% pb_design
pb_library <- Matrix::colSums(pb_counts)

stopifnot(all(pb_library > 0))

target_genes <- unique(validation_gene_map$gene)
pb_count_target <- as.matrix(pb_counts[target_genes, , drop = FALSE])
pb_log2_cpm <- log2(t(t(pb_count_target) / pb_library) * 1e6 + 1)

pb_observed <- as.data.frame(as.table(pb_log2_cpm), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(pb_observed) <- c("gene", "cluster_sample", "log2_cpm")

pb_raw <- as.data.frame(as.table(pb_count_target), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(pb_raw) <- c("gene", "cluster_sample", "pseudobulk_count")

cluster_sample_meta <- meta_pb %>%
  dplyr::count(
    cluster_sample, author_cluster, condition, time_type, time_num,
    biological_repeat, biological_sample,
    name = "n_cells"
  )

pb_observed <- pb_observed %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pb_raw, by = c("gene", "cluster_sample")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cluster_sample_meta, by = "cluster_sample") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(validation_gene_map, by = c("gene", "author_cluster")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
    time_label = ifelse(
      condition == "LD",
      sprintf("ZT%02d", time_num),
      sprintf("CT%02d", time_num)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(validation_role, gene, condition, time_num, biological_repeat)

pb_time_mean <- pb_observed %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    gene, author_cluster, validation_role, seed_independent_reference,
    condition, time_type, time_num
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_log2_cpm = mean(log2_cpm),
    sd_log2_cpm = if (dplyr::n() > 1L) stats::sd(log2_cpm) else NA_real_,
    n_biological_samples = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pb_harmonic_groups <- pb_observed %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, author_cluster, condition) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(gene, author_cluster, condition)
pb_harmonic_curve_list <- vector("list", nrow(pb_harmonic_groups))
pb_harmonic_diagnostic_list <- vector("list", nrow(pb_harmonic_groups))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pb_harmonic_groups))) {
  gene_now <- pb_harmonic_groups$gene[i]
  cluster_now <- pb_harmonic_groups$author_cluster[i]
  condition_now <- as.character(pb_harmonic_groups$condition[i])
  observed_now <- pb_observed %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_now, author_cluster == cluster_now, condition == condition_now) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
      cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
    )
  fit_now <- stats::lm(log2_cpm ~ sin24 + cos24, data = observed_now)
  grid_now <- tibble::tibble(
    time_num = seq(0, 24, length.out = 241),
    sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
    cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
  )
  prediction_now <- as.data.frame(stats::predict(
    fit_now, newdata = grid_now, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95
  ))
  ci_supported <- nrow(observed_now) >= 8L &&
    dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num) == 6L &&
    stats::df.residual(fit_now) >= 5L && fit_now$rank == 3L &&
    all(is.finite(as.matrix(prediction_now)))

  pb_harmonic_curve_list[[i]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(grid_now, prediction_now) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene = gene_now, author_cluster = cluster_now,
      display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
        match(cluster_now, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
      ],
      condition = factor(condition_now, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
      time_num, fitted_log2_cpm = fit, ci_low = lwr, ci_high = upr,
      draw_ci = ci_supported
    )
  pb_harmonic_diagnostic_list[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    gene = gene_now, author_cluster = cluster_now, condition = condition_now,
    n_biological_samples = nrow(observed_now),
    n_timepoints = dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num),
    residual_df = stats::df.residual(fit_now), model_rank = fit_now$rank,
    ci_supported = ci_supported,
    interpretation = "descriptive 24 h biological-sample observed-time harmonic LM; not an SRB fit"
  )
}

pb_harmonic_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(pb_harmonic_curve_list)
pb_harmonic_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(pb_harmonic_diagnostic_list)

readr::write_csv(
  validation_gene_map,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "validation_gene_manifest.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  pb_observed,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "observed_pseudobulk_log2cpm_by_biological_sample.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  pb_time_mean,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "observed_pseudobulk_timepoint_means.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  pb_harmonic_curves,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "observed_pseudobulk_harmonic_curves.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  pb_harmonic_diagnostics,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "observed_pseudobulk_harmonic_diagnostics.csv")
)
```

The pseudobulk value is the raw RNA-count sum within one author cluster and one biological sample, normalized by that cluster-sample library size as `log2(CPM + 1)`. Points are independent biological samples; lines connect the arithmetic mean of the represented samples at each time. AR plates are not treated as biological replicates.

LD uses the observed ZT labels and DD uses the observed CT labels. The common numeric positions align the six recorded clock times but do not impose a shared SRB phase origin. DN2 lacks a represented second LD biological sample at ZT18 and ZT22, and several samples contain only one or two DN2 cells; the figure is therefore descriptive reproduction rather than an independent condition effect test.

# 25. Existing Panel I amplitude and phase uncertainty

```{r panel-m-existing-param-comparison, eval=TRUE, fig.width=8.6, fig.height=9.2}
param_I_diagnostics <- param_I_saved$fit_diagnostics %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    curve_stratum,
    into = c("condition", "author_cluster"),
    sep = " \\| ",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene, condition, author_cluster,
    N_samples, Sample_score_valid_fraction, Sample_status,
    Shrink_status, Hessian_status
  )

param_I_statistics <- param_I_saved$param_long %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, curve_stratum, P_value, FDR)

param_I_comparison <- param_I_saved$bootstrap_res %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    curve_stratum,
    into = c("condition", "author_cluster"),
    sep = " \\| ",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    gene_panel_I_saved,
    by = c("gene", "author_cluster")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    param_I_diagnostics,
    by = c("gene", "condition", "author_cluster")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    param_I_statistics,
    by = c("gene", "curve_stratum")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ],
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ],
    gene_panel = paste0(gene, "\n", display_cluster),
    Phase_CI_wraps = Phase_CI_low > Phase_CI_high,
    Phase_est_in_CI = dplyr::if_else(
      Phase_CI_wraps,
      Phase_est >= Phase_CI_low | Phase_est <= Phase_CI_high,
      Phase_est >= Phase_CI_low & Phase_est <= Phase_CI_high
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(gene, gene_panel_I_saved$gene), condition)

stopifnot(
  nrow(param_I_comparison) == 2L * nrow(gene_panel_I_saved),
  all(param_I_comparison$Bootstrap_valid_fraction > 0),
  all(is.finite(param_I_comparison$Amp_CI_low)),
  all(is.finite(param_I_comparison$Phase_CI_low)),
  all(param_I_comparison$Phase_est_in_CI)
)

parameter_supp_genes <- gene_panel_I_saved$gene
parameter_main_genes <- c("CrebA", "DIP-beta", "pdm3")

parameter_supp_data <- param_I_comparison %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

condition_line_pal <- c("LD" = "#548E72", "DD" = "#8A70A5")

make_parameter_forest <- function(plot_data, phase_data, gene_order) {
  gene_labels <- rev(
    plot_data %>%
      dplyr::distinct(gene, display_cluster) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(match(gene, gene_order)) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(label = paste0(gene, "\n", display_cluster)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(label)
  )
  gene_breaks <- seq_along(gene_order)

  p_amp <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = Amp_CI_low, xend = Amp_CI_high,
        y = y_plot, yend = y_plot, colour = condition
      ),
      linewidth = 1.6, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(x = Amplitude_est, y = y_plot, fill = condition, colour = condition),
      shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1.1
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = condition_line_pal, breaks = c("LD", "DD"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = group_pal, breaks = c("LD", "DD"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.07))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = gene_breaks, labels = gene_labels,
      limits = c(0.5, length(gene_order) + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Amplitude", y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 26, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, colour = "#242424"),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", colour = "#242424"),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 16, 8, 10)
    )

  p_phase <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = phase_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = x, xend = xend,
        y = y_plot, yend = y_plot, colour = condition
      ),
      linewidth = 1.6, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(x = Phase_est, y = y_plot, fill = condition, colour = condition),
      shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1.1
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = condition_line_pal, breaks = c("LD", "DD"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = group_pal, breaks = c("LD", "DD"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2, 2 * pi),
      labels = c("0", "pi/2", "pi", "3pi/2", "2pi"),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.012, 0.012))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = gene_breaks, labels = NULL,
      limits = c(0.5, length(gene_order) + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Phase (rad)", y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 26, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, colour = "#242424"),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 16, 8, 10)
    )

  (p_amp | p_phase) + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 1)) &
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top")
}

p_M_main <- make_parameter_forest(
```

The phase intervals are circular: an interval with a lower endpoint larger than its upper endpoint is drawn as two edge segments at `0/2π`; wide non-wrapping intervals are retained exactly as estimated. These plots read the existing Panel I bootstrap output and do not refit any gene. The main version prioritizes `CrebA`, `DIP-beta` and `pdm3`, while the five-gene version remains supplementary. No DN2-specific SRB curve is added because the saved all-gene LD object is pooled across author clusters and no saved, matched DN2 LD/DD gene-parameter fit with uncertainty is available.

# 26. Biological-validation output contract

```{r biological-validation-output-contract, eval=TRUE}
biological_validation_contract <- tibble::tribble(
  ~panel, ~unit, ~source, ~interpretation,
  "J", "biological sample within display 14:DN2 (author 19)", "raw RNA counts; observed log2(CPM + 1)", "tim/vri seed-gene reproduction; not independent validation",
  "J supplement", "biological sample within display 14:DN2 (author 19)", "raw RNA counts; observed log2(CPM + 1)", "per positive-control seed; not independent validation",
  "K", "biological sample within published author cluster", "raw RNA counts; observed log2(CPM + 1)", "five pre-specified non-seed references; no new significance label",
  "L main", "display 14:DN2, 2:s_LNv and 1:DN1p_CNMa by condition and sampling time", "saved metadata", "compact coverage and interpretability audit",
  "L supplement", "17 author clusters by condition and sampling time", "saved metadata", "complete coverage and interpretability audit",
  "M main", "CrebA, DIP-beta and pdm3 fits in published author clusters", "saved Panel I bootstrap result", "descriptive amplitude and circular phase with CI; no refit",
  "M supplement", "five non-seed gene fits in published author clusters", "saved Panel I bootstrap result", "expanded descriptive amplitude and circular phase with CI; no refit"
)

readr::write_csv(
  biological_validation_contract,
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "biological_validation_output_contract.csv")
)
writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "sessionInfo_biological_validation.txt")
)

biological_validation_contract
```

For the manuscript Results, the 17 author-defined clock-neuron classes establish the analysis landscape and its sampling support. The DN2 `tim`/`vri` trajectories are an observational reproduction of a published phenomenon, but both genes are phase seeds and therefore do not constitute independent validation. The non-seed gene-level amplitude, phase and bootstrap intervals demonstrate the interpretable SRB output in published cell-type contexts; a systematic published-gene concordance analysis remains to be completed before making a broad recovery claim.

```{r cellstyle-observed-harmonic, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```
