```{r cellstyle-observed-harmonic, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
write_patchwork_panel_layout <- function(
  plot,
  manifest_path,
  width_in,
  height_in,
  panel_ids = NULL,
  row_groups = NULL,
  column_groups = NULL,
  exemptions = list()
) {
  grob <- patchwork::patchworkGrob(plot)
  panel_rows <- .nature_alignment_panel_rows(grob)
  if (is.null(panel_ids)) {
    panel_ids <- letters[seq_len(nrow(panel_rows))]
  }
  stopifnot(length(panel_ids) == nrow(panel_rows), !anyDuplicated(panel_ids))

  probe_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
  grDevices::pdf(probe_path, width = width_in, height = height_in, useDingbats = FALSE)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(grob)
  grid::grid.force()

  viewport_names <- unique(grid::grid.ls(viewports = TRUE, print = FALSE)$name)
  panel_viewports <- viewport_names[
    grepl("^panel-[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$", viewport_names)
  ]
  panel_order <- as.integer(sub("^panel-([0-9]+)\\..*$", "\\1", panel_viewports))
  panel_viewports <- panel_viewports[order(panel_order)]
  stopifnot(length(panel_viewports) == nrow(panel_rows))

  panels <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(panel_rows)), function(index) {
    grid::seekViewport(panel_viewports[index])
    bottom_left <- grid::deviceLoc(
      grid::unit(0, "npc"), grid::unit(0, "npc"), valueOnly = TRUE
    )
    top_right <- grid::deviceLoc(
      grid::unit(1, "npc"), grid::unit(1, "npc"), valueOnly = TRUE
    )
    row <- panel_rows[index, ]
    list(
      id = panel_ids[index],
      bbox_pt = unname(c(
        bottom_left$x, bottom_left$y,
        top_right$x, top_right$y
      ) * 72),
      grid_id = "patchwork-grid-1",
      row_start = as.integer(row$t - 1),
      row_stop = as.integer(row$b),
      col_start = as.integer(row$l - 1),
      col_stop = as.integer(row$r)
    )
  })

  grDevices::dev.off()
  unlink(probe_path)

  manifest <- list(
    schema_version = 1L,
    backend = "r-patchwork",
    figure = list(width_pt = width_in * 72, height_pt = height_in * 72),
    panels = panels,
    exemptions = exemptions
  )
  normalized_rows <- .nature_alignment_groups(row_groups)
  normalized_columns <- .nature_alignment_groups(column_groups)
  if (!is.null(normalized_rows)) manifest$row_groups <- normalized_rows
  if (!is.null(normalized_columns)) manifest$column_groups <- normalized_columns

  dir.create(dirname(manifest_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  jsonlite::write_json(
    manifest,
    manifest_path,
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    pretty = TRUE,
    digits = NA
  )
  invisible(manifest)
}
write_patchwork_panel_layout_viewport <- write_patchwork_panel_layout

condition_fill <- c("LD" = "#D8EADE", "DD" = "#D5CAE3")
condition_line <- c("LD" = "#548E72", "DD" = "#8A70A5")
time_breaks <- c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)

pb_cellstyle <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(validation_plot_dir, "observed_pseudobulk_log2cpm_by_biological_sample.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD"))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, author_cluster, condition, time_num) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(biological_repeat, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    point_time = time_num + if (dplyr::n() == 1L) {
      0
    } else {
      seq(-0.12, 0.12, length.out = dplyr::n())
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

harmonic_groups <- pb_cellstyle %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, author_cluster, condition) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(gene, author_cluster, condition)

harmonic_curve_list <- vector("list", nrow(harmonic_groups))
harmonic_diagnostic_list <- vector("list", nrow(harmonic_groups))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(harmonic_groups))) {
  gene_now <- harmonic_groups$gene[i]
  cluster_now <- harmonic_groups$author_cluster[i]
  condition_now <- harmonic_groups$condition[i]

  observed_now <- pb_cellstyle %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene == gene_now,
      author_cluster == cluster_now,
      condition == condition_now
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
      cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
    )

  harmonic_fit <- stats::lm(log2_cpm ~ sin24 + cos24, data = observed_now)
  harmonic_null <- stats::lm(log2_cpm ~ 1, data = observed_now)
  model_comparison <- stats::anova(harmonic_null, harmonic_fit)
  fit_summary <- summary(harmonic_fit)
  fit_coef <- stats::coef(harmonic_fit)

  curve_now <- tibble::tibble(
    time_num = seq(0, 24, length.out = 241),
    sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
    cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
  )
  curve_prediction <- as.data.frame(stats::predict(
    harmonic_fit,
    newdata = curve_now,
    interval = "confidence",
    level = 0.95
  ))

  ci_reliable <- nrow(observed_now) >= 8L &&
    dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num) == 6L &&
    stats::df.residual(harmonic_fit) >= 5L &&
    harmonic_fit$rank == 3L &&
    all(is.finite(curve_prediction$fit))

  harmonic_curve_list[[i]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(curve_now, curve_prediction) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene = gene_now,
      author_cluster = cluster_now,
      condition = factor(condition_now, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
      time_num,
      fitted_log2_cpm = fit,
      ci_low = lwr,
      ci_high = upr,
      draw_ci = ci_reliable
    )

  harmonic_diagnostic_list[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    gene = gene_now,
    author_cluster = cluster_now,
    condition = as.character(condition_now),
    n_biological_samples = nrow(observed_now),
    n_timepoints = dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num),
    residual_df = stats::df.residual(harmonic_fit),
    model_rank = harmonic_fit$rank,
    r_squared = fit_summary$r.squared,
    adjusted_r_squared = fit_summary$adj.r.squared,
    harmonic_model_p = model_comparison$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    amplitude_log2_cpm = sqrt(fit_coef[["cos24"]]^2 + fit_coef[["sin24"]]^2),
    peak_time_hours = (
      atan2(fit_coef[["sin24"]], fit_coef[["cos24"]]) %% (2 * pi)
    ) * 24 / (2 * pi),
    interval = if (ci_reliable) {
      "95% confidence interval for the fitted mean"
    } else {
      "not drawn: insufficient sample/time/model support"
    },
    interpretation = "descriptive 24 h sample-level harmonic fit; not an SRB fit"
  )
}

harmonic_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(harmonic_curve_list)
harmonic_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(harmonic_diagnostic_list)

readr::write_csv(
  harmonic_curves,
  file.path(cellstyle_dir, "observed_harmonic_fitted_curves.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  harmonic_diagnostics,
  file.path(cellstyle_dir, "observed_harmonic_fit_diagnostics.csv")
)

make_cellstyle_observed_plot <- function(gene_now, cluster_now) {
  observed_now <- pb_cellstyle %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_now, author_cluster == cluster_now)
  curve_now <- harmonic_curves %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_now, author_cluster == cluster_now)
  display_now <- clock_display_map$display_label[
    match(cluster_now, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
  ]

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = curve_now %>% dplyr::filter(draw_ci),
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = time_num, ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high,
        fill = condition, group = condition
      ),
      alpha = 0.50,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = curve_now,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = time_num, y = fitted_log2_cpm,
        colour = condition, group = condition
      ),
      linewidth = 1.65,
      lineend = "round",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = observed_now,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = point_time, y = log2_cpm,
        fill = condition, colour = condition
      ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 4.1,
      stroke = 1.05,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = condition_line,
      breaks = c("LD", "DD"),
      labels = c("LD", "DD (CT)"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = condition_fill,
      breaks = c("LD", "DD"),
      labels = c("LD", "DD (CT)"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 24),
      breaks = time_breaks,
      labels = sprintf("%02d", time_breaks),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "<b>", gene_now, "</b><br>",
        "<span style='font-size:14pt;color:#333333'>", display_now, "</span>"
      ),
      x = "ZT",
      y = "log2(CPM + 1)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 17, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(
        size = 30, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.95,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 8)
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.16, "cm"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 18, face = "bold",
        margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 12, r = 8)
      ),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(2, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.45, "cm"),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 12, 8, 10)
    )
}
```

```{r cellstyle-srb-predicted-phase, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
srb_curve_cellstyle <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_I_fitted_curves.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD")))

make_cellstyle_srb_plot <- function(gene_now, cluster_now) {
  curve_now <- srb_curve_cellstyle %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_now, author_cluster == cluster_now)
  display_now <- clock_display_map$display_label[
    match(cluster_now, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
  ]

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    curve_now,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = theta_pred,
      y = fitted_expression,
      colour = condition,
      group = condition
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      linewidth = 1.75,
      lineend = "round",
      key_glyph = "point"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = condition_line,
      breaks = c("LD", "DD"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(size = 5)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2, 2 * pi),
      labels = expression(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2, 2 * pi),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "<b>", gene_now, "</b><br>",
        "<span style='font-size:14pt;color:#333333'>", display_now, "</span>"
      ),
      x = "Phase (rad)",
      y = "Normalized expression"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 17, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(
        size = 30, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.95,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 8)
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.16, "cm"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 18, face = "bold",
        margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 12, r = 8)
      ),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(2, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.45, "cm"),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 12, 8, 10)
    )
}

  svglite::svglite(
    file.path(cellstyle_dir, paste0(figure_name, ".svg")),
    width = width_now,
    height = height_now
  )
  print(figure_now)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  ragg::agg_png(
    file.path(cellstyle_dir, paste0(figure_name, ".png")),
    width = width_now,
    height = height_now,
    units = "in",
    res = 600,
    background = "white"
  )
  print(figure_now)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}
```

# 29. LD/DD cell-type prioritization audit from saved outputs

This section is a retrospective audit of whether the saved rho, phase-distribution DTW and CellAlign outputs prioritize the three literature reference cases specified before ranking: `19:DN2`, `2:s_LNv` and `1:DN1p_CNMa`. It does not rerun phase inference, gene inference, Seurat processing, integration or CellAlign.

```{r prioritization-input, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

priority_figure_dir <- file.path(priority_dir, "figures")
priority_reference_dir <- file.path(priority_dir, "reference")

dir.create(priority_reference_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

The biological sample is the condition, sampling time and author repeat. AR identifiers and raw matrix files are technical partitions within those samples and are not used as independent replicates.

# 30. Cell and biological-sample coverage

```{r prioritization-coverage, eval=TRUE}
coverage_by_sample_priority <- meta_priority %>%
  dplyr::count(
    author_cluster, biological_sample,
    condition, time_num, biological_repeat,
    name = "n_cells"
  )

coverage_by_sample_priority <- tidyr::crossing(
  author_cluster = author_levels_priority,
  sample_lookup_priority
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    coverage_by_sample_priority,
    by = c(
      "author_cluster", "biological_sample", "condition",
      "time_num", "biological_repeat"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_cells = tidyr::replace_na(n_cells, 0L),
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(author_cluster, condition, time_num, biological_repeat)

coverage_by_time_priority <- coverage_by_sample_priority %>%
  dplyr::group_by(author_cluster, display_cluster, condition, time_num) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = sum(n_cells),
    n_samples_any = sum(n_cells > 0),
    n_samples_ge3 = sum(n_cells >= 3),
    n_samples_ge5 = sum(n_cells >= 5),
    n_samples_ge10 = sum(n_cells >= 10),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

coverage_by_condition_priority <- coverage_by_time_priority %>%
  dplyr::group_by(author_cluster, display_cluster, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = sum(n_cells),
    n_samples_any = sum(n_samples_any),
    n_samples_ge3 = sum(n_samples_ge3),
    n_samples_ge5 = sum(n_samples_ge5),
    n_samples_ge10 = sum(n_samples_ge10),
    n_timepoints_any = sum(n_samples_any > 0),
    n_timepoints_two_samples_ge3 = sum(n_samples_ge3 == 2L),
    n_timepoints_two_samples_ge5 = sum(n_samples_ge5 == 2L),
    n_timepoints_two_samples_ge10 = sum(n_samples_ge10 == 2L),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

coverage_wide_priority <- coverage_by_condition_priority %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = c(
      n_cells, n_samples_any, n_samples_ge3, n_samples_ge5, n_samples_ge10,
      n_timepoints_any, n_timepoints_two_samples_ge3,
      n_timepoints_two_samples_ge5, n_timepoints_two_samples_ge10
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{condition}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_cells_total = n_cells_LD + n_cells_DD,
    coverage_quality = dplyr::case_when(
      n_samples_ge3_LD == 12L & n_samples_ge3_DD == 12L ~ "complete at n_cell >= 3",
      n_samples_ge3_LD >= 9L & n_samples_ge3_DD >= 9L ~ "partial at n_cell >= 3",
      TRUE ~ "sparse at n_cell >= 3"
    )
  )

readr::write_csv(
  coverage_by_sample_priority,
  file.path(priority_dir, "celltype_coverage_by_biological_sample.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  coverage_by_time_priority,
  file.path(priority_dir, "celltype_coverage_by_condition_time.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
```

# 31. Rho prioritization audit

```{r rho-prioritization-audit, eval=TRUE, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
rho_sample_priority <- rho_saved$rho_sample %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell_type = as.character(cell_type),
    Group = as.character(Group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_lookup_priority,
    by = c("Sample" = "biological_sample", "Group" = "condition")
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(rho_sample_priority$time_num), all(rho_sample_priority$n_cell >= 3L))

rho_sensitivity_long <- tidyr::crossing(
  min_cell_threshold = c(3L, 5L, 10L),
  rho_sample_priority
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_cell >= min_cell_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(min_cell_threshold, cell_type, Group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sample = dplyr::n(),
    n_timepoint = dplyr::n_distinct(time_num),
    mean_n_cell = mean(n_cell),
    rho_mean = mean(rho),
    rho_median = median(rho),
    rho_sd = if (dplyr::n() > 1L) stats::sd(rho) else NA_real_,
    rho_q025 = stats::quantile(rho, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    rho_q975 = stats::quantile(rho, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rho_sensitivity_wide <- rho_sensitivity_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = c(
      n_sample, n_timepoint, mean_n_cell,
      rho_mean, rho_median, rho_sd, rho_q025, rho_q975
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Group}"
  )

rho_sensitivity_wide <- tidyr::crossing(
  min_cell_threshold = c(3L, 5L, 10L),
  author_cluster = author_levels_priority
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rho_sensitivity_wide,
    by = c("min_cell_threshold", "author_cluster" = "cell_type")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_sample_LD = tidyr::replace_na(n_sample_LD, 0L),
    n_sample_DD = tidyr::replace_na(n_sample_DD, 0L),
    n_timepoint_LD = tidyr::replace_na(n_timepoint_LD, 0L),
    n_timepoint_DD = tidyr::replace_na(n_timepoint_DD, 0L),
    rho_delta_DD_minus_LD = dplyr::if_else(
      n_sample_LD > 0L & n_sample_DD > 0L,
      rho_mean_DD - rho_mean_LD,
      NA_real_
    ),
    abs_rho_delta = abs(rho_delta_DD_minus_LD)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(min_cell_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rho_rank = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(abs_rho_delta))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

rho_priority_min3 <- rho_sensitivity_wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(min_cell_threshold == 3L) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rho_sig_saved %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        author_cluster = cell_type,
        rho_n_LD_test = n_group1,
        rho_n_DD_test = n_group2,
        rho_p_value_saved = p_value,
        rho_FDR_saved = p_adj,
        rho_test_eligible = eligible
      ),
    by = "author_cluster"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(coverage_wide_priority %>% dplyr::select(-display_cluster), by = "author_cluster") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rho_delta_CI_low = NA_real_,
    rho_delta_CI_high = NA_real_,
    rho_delta_CI_status = "not available in the saved run; sample quantiles are not a CI for the LD/DD delta",
    retrospective_reference = author_cluster %in% reference_clusters,
    rho_direction = dplyr::if_else(
      rho_delta_DD_minus_LD >= 0,
      "DD higher rho",
      "LD higher rho"
    )
  )

rho_by_time_priority <- rho_sample_priority %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_cell >= 3L) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type, time_num, Group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sample = dplyr::n(),
    rho_mean = mean(rho),
    rho_median = median(rho),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = c(n_sample, rho_mean, rho_median),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Group}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(author_cluster = cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rho_delta_DD_minus_LD = rho_mean_DD - rho_mean_LD,
    status = dplyr::if_else(
      n_sample_LD == 2L & n_sample_DD == 2L,
      "two represented biological repeats in both conditions",
      "descriptive only; incomplete n_cell >= 3 repeat coverage"
    )
  )

rho_plot_data <- rho_priority_min3 %>%
  dplyr::arrange(abs_rho_delta) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    author_cluster = factor(author_cluster, levels = author_cluster),
    display_cluster = factor(display_cluster, levels = display_cluster),
    reference_status = dplyr::if_else(
      retrospective_reference,
      "Predefined reference",
      "Other cluster"
    )
  )

p_rho_priority <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rho_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = abs_rho_delta, y = display_cluster)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = abs_rho_delta, yend = display_cluster),
    linewidth = 1.1, colour = "#B9B9B9"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(fill = rho_direction, shape = reference_status),
    size = 4.8, stroke = 1, colour = "#303030"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("LD higher rho" = group_pal[["LD"]], "DD higher rho" = group_pal[["DD"]]),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Predefined reference" = 23, "Other cluster" = 21),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Sample-level rho prioritization",
    x = "|mean rho(DD) - mean rho(LD)|",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 27, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, colour = "#222222"),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, colour = "#222222"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 18, 10, 10)
  )

readr::write_csv(rho_sample_priority, file.path(priority_dir, "rho_precomputed_sample_values.csv"))
readr::write_csv(rho_sensitivity_long, file.path(priority_dir, "rho_threshold_sensitivity_long.csv"))
readr::write_csv(rho_sensitivity_wide, file.path(priority_dir, "rho_threshold_sensitivity_rank.csv"))
readr::write_csv(rho_priority_min3, file.path(priority_dir, "rho_prioritization_min3.csv"))
readr::write_csv(rho_by_time_priority, file.path(priority_dir, "rho_timepoint_descriptive_delta.csv"))
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(priority_figure_dir, "rho_prioritization_min3.pdf"),
  p_rho_priority, width = 9.5, height = 9.5, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, bg = "white"
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(priority_figure_dir, "rho_prioritization_min3.png"),
  p_rho_priority, width = 9.5, height = 9.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white"
)

p_rho_priority
```

The `n_cell >= 5` and `n_cell >= 10` rows filter the already computed sample-level rho values. They do not rerun phase inference or rho estimation. The saved BH result is retained only for the original `n_cell >= 3` analysis. The displayed 2.5% and 97.5% values are empirical sample-distribution quantiles, not confidence intervals for the LD/DD delta.

# 32. Phase-distribution DTW prioritization audit

```{r phase-dtw-prioritization-audit, eval=TRUE, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
dtw_combo_LD <- paste0(author_levels_priority, " | LD")
dtw_combo_DD <- paste0(author_levels_priority, " | DD")

stopifnot(
  all(dtw_combo_LD %in% rownames(dtw_saved$distance)),
  all(dtw_combo_DD %in% colnames(dtw_saved$distance)),
  all(dtw_saved$combo$n_cell >= dtw_saved$params$min_cell)
)

dtw_circular_saved <- as.matrix(utils::read.delim(
  priority_files$path[priority_files$object == "phase DTW circular sensitivity"],
  row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE
))
dtw_shift_saved <- as.matrix(utils::read.delim(
  priority_files$path[priority_files$object == "phase DTW circular shift"],
  row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE
))

dtw_count_priority <- dtw_saved$combo %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = as.character(cell_type), Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, Group, n_cell) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = n_cell,
    names_prefix = "n_cell_"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(author_cluster = cell_type)

phase_dtw_priority <- tibble::tibble(
  author_cluster = author_levels_priority,
  phase_DTW_raw_distance = vapply(
    author_levels_priority,
    function(x) dtw_saved$distance[paste0(x, " | LD"), paste0(x, " | DD")],
    numeric(1)
  ),
  within_matrix_similarity = vapply(
    author_levels_priority,
    function(x) dtw_saved$similarity[paste0(x, " | LD"), paste0(x, " | DD")],
    numeric(1)
  ),
  circular_shift_min_distance = vapply(
    author_levels_priority,
    function(x) dtw_circular_saved[paste0(x, " | LD"), paste0(x, " | DD")],
    numeric(1)
  ),
  circular_best_shift_bin = vapply(
    author_levels_priority,
    function(x) dtw_shift_saved[paste0(x, " | LD"), paste0(x, " | DD")],
    numeric(1)
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dtw_count_priority, by = "author_cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(coverage_wide_priority %>% dplyr::select(-display_cluster), by = "author_cluster") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ],
    phase_DTW_rank = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(phase_DTW_raw_distance)),
    circular_shift_rank = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(circular_shift_min_distance)),
    boundary_distance_ratio = circular_shift_min_distance / phase_DTW_raw_distance,
    rank_shift_after_circular_rotation = circular_shift_rank - phase_DTW_rank,
    passes_saved_min_cell = n_cell_LD >= dtw_saved$params$min_cell &
      n_cell_DD >= dtw_saved$params$min_cell,
    sample_rank_interval_low = NA_real_,
    sample_rank_interval_high = NA_real_,
    sample_rank_interval_status = dplyr::if_else(
      n_timepoints_two_samples_ge3_LD == 6L & n_timepoints_two_samples_ge3_DD == 6L,
      "not estimated: only two independent biological repeats per timepoint",
      "not estimated: incomplete n_cell >= 3 repeat coverage and only two repeats per timepoint"
    ),
    retrospective_reference = author_cluster %in% reference_clusters,
    similarity_interpretation = "within-matrix min-max visualization only; not an absolute effect size"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(phase_DTW_rank)

phase_dtw_plot_data <- phase_dtw_priority %>%
  dplyr::arrange(phase_DTW_raw_distance) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    author_cluster = factor(author_cluster, levels = author_cluster),
    display_cluster = factor(display_cluster, levels = display_cluster),
    reference_status = dplyr::if_else(
      retrospective_reference,
      "Predefined reference",
      "Other cluster"
    )
  )

p_phase_dtw_priority <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  phase_dtw_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(y = display_cluster)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = circular_shift_min_distance,
      xend = phase_DTW_raw_distance,
      yend = display_cluster
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2, colour = "#B9B9B9"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = phase_DTW_raw_distance,
      shape = reference_status,
      colour = "Linear 24-bin DTW"
    ),
    size = 4.8, stroke = 1.1
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = circular_shift_min_distance,
      shape = reference_status,
      colour = "Circular-shift minimum"
    ),
    size = 4.2, stroke = 1.1
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Linear 24-bin DTW" = "#222222",
      "Circular-shift minimum" = "#A77844"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Predefined reference" = 17, "Other cluster" = 16),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Phase-distribution DTW prioritization",
    x = "Path-length-normalized DTW distance",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 27, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, colour = "#222222"),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, colour = "#222222"),

    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),

  )

readr::write_csv(phase_dtw_priority, file.path(priority_dir, "phase_DTW_prioritization.csv"))
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(priority_figure_dir, "phase_DTW_prioritization.pdf"),
  p_phase_dtw_priority, width = 9.5, height = 9.5,

p_phase_dtw_priority
```

The linear distance is the raw path-length-normalized distance used before the 34×34 matrix is min-max transformed for the heatmap. The saved sensitivity result minimizes distance over all 24 circular shifts and therefore permits a global phase rotation; it is a stronger sensitivity analysis than merely joining the first and last bins. With only two biological repeats per timepoint, no stable sample-aware rank interval is claimed.

```{r expression-dtw-prioritization-audit, eval=TRUE, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
cellalign_gene_sets <- unique(cellalign_summary_saved$genes)

  length(cellalign_gene_sets) == 1L,
  all(cellalign_summary_saved$n_gene == 12L),
  all(phase_seed_genes %in% cellalign_gene_set),
  setequal(names(cellalign_saved), author_levels_priority),
  all(vapply(cellalign_saved, function(x) nrow(x$localCostMatrix) == 30L, logical(1))),
  all(vapply(cellalign_saved, function(x) ncol(x$localCostMatrix) == 30L, logical(1))),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    unname(cellalign_summary_saved$normalized_distance),
    unname(vapply(
      cellalign_summary_saved$author_cluster,

p_expression_dtw_priority
```

All 17 saved alignments use the same 12 genes, the same log-normalization, the same scaling procedure and 30 points per trajectory. Their normalized distances are therefore comparable within this saved analysis. The panel contains six phase seeds and six non-seed examples. A seed-excluded rank cannot be recovered from the saved alignment objects without recomputing CellAlign and is reported as unavailable.

```{r prioritization-comparison, eval=TRUE, fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
published_cluster_summary <- published_cyclers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(author_cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

  ~author_cluster, ~retrospective_reference, ~published_evidence_status,

  "1:DN1p_CNMa", TRUE, "predefined retrospective exemplar: pdm3 and beat-Va rhythms"
)

prioritization_comparison <- tibble::tibble(

) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rho_priority_min3 %>%
      dplyr::select(

      ),

  dplyr::left_join(
    expression_dtw_priority %>%

      ),
    by = "author_cluster"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(coverage_wide_priority %>% dplyr::select(-display_cluster), by = "author_cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(published_cluster_summary, by = "author_cluster") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(literature_reference_priority, by = "author_cluster") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ],
    retrospective_reference = tidyr::replace_na(retrospective_reference, FALSE),

      published_evidence_status,

    ),
    rho_rank_normalized = (rho_rank - 1) / (length(author_levels_priority) - 1),
    phase_DTW_rank_normalized = (phase_DTW_rank - 1) / (length(author_levels_priority) - 1),
    expression_DTW_rank_normalized = (expression_DTW_rank - 1) / (length(author_levels_priority) - 1)
  )

prioritization_rank_long <- prioritization_comparison %>%
  dplyr::select(
    author_cluster, display_cluster, retrospective_reference,
    rho_rank, phase_DTW_rank, expression_DTW_rank
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rho_rank, phase_DTW_rank, expression_DTW_rank),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("rho_rank", "phase_DTW_rank", "expression_DTW_rank"),
      labels = c("rho delta", "phase DTW", "expression DTW")
    ),
    rank_normalized = (rank - 1) / (length(author_levels_priority) - 1),
    cluster_label = dplyr::if_else(
      retrospective_reference,
      paste0("* ", display_cluster),

    ),
    cluster_label = factor(cluster_label, levels = rev(unique(cluster_label)))
  )

rank_stability_priority <- tibble::tribble(
  ~metric_1, ~metric_2, ~spearman_rank_correlation,

  ),
  "rho delta", "expression DTW", stats::cor(

)

sparsity_association_priority <- tibble::tibble(

        prioritization_comparison$n_samples_ge3_LD,
        prioritization_comparison$n_samples_ge3_DD
      ),
      method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"
    )
  ),
  interpretation = "descriptive association; negative values indicate larger apparent effects in sparser clusters"
)

p_prioritization_rank <- ggplot2::ggplot(
```

The rank heatmap places the three dimensions side by side and does not average them into a composite score. An asterisk marks the three prespecified retrospective reference cases. Rank 1 is the largest LD/DD difference within that metric.

```{r published-gene-closure, eval=TRUE, fig.width=8, fig.height=9.8}
published_scope_priority <- tibble::tibble(

param_diagnostics_priority <- param_priority$fit_diagnostics %>%

  )

gene_parameter_priority <- param_priority$bootstrap_res %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    curve_stratum,
    into = c("condition", "author_cluster"),
    sep = " \\| ",
    remove = FALSE

  dplyr::inner_join(
    gene_panel_priority,
    by = c("gene", "author_cluster")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    param_statistics_priority,
    by = c("gene", "curve_stratum")

  dplyr::left_join(

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
    phase_est_hours = Phase_est * 24 / (2 * pi),
    phase_CI_low_hours = Phase_CI_low * 24 / (2 * pi),
    phase_CI_high_hours = Phase_CI_high * 24 / (2 * pi),
    phase_CI_wraps = Phase_CI_low > Phase_CI_high,

      ),
      NA_real_
    ),
    SRB_FDR_005 = FDR < 0.05,
    evidence_category = dplyr::case_when(
      published_listed & SRB_FDR_005 ~ "published and SRB FDR < 0.05",
      published_listed ~ "published; SRB FDR >= 0.05",
      SRB_FDR_005 ~ "not listed in supplement; SRB FDR < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ "not listed in supplement; SRB FDR >= 0.05"
    ),
    validation_scope = "preselected non-seed gene-cluster pair; not genome-wide recovery"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

gene_plot_data <- gene_parameter_priority %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(FDR)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    row_label = paste0(gene, " | ", condition, " | ", display_cluster),

p_gene_closure <- ggplot2::ggplot(

) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(

```

`tim` and `vri` in `19:DN2` are phase seeds and remain an observed-expression reproduction of the published antiphase case. They are not counted as independent gene-level validation. The non-seed comparison uses the existing sample-aware Panel I fit and its saved bootstrap intervals. Supplementary file 1 is a published reference list, not a gold-standard truth set; absence from the list is not treated as a true negative. The pooled all-gene LD fit is not cell-type-specific and is not used to calculate a genome-wide recovery rate.

# 36. Autogenerated candidate summary

```{r prioritization-summary, eval=TRUE}
reference_rank_priority <- prioritization_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(retrospective_reference) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(reference_order = match(author_cluster, reference_clusters)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(reference_order)

reference_rank_text <- paste0(
  reference_rank_priority$display_cluster,
  " [author ", reference_rank_priority$author_cluster, "]",
  " (rho ", reference_rank_priority$rho_rank,
  ", phase DTW ", reference_rank_priority$phase_DTW_rank,
  ", expression DTW ", reference_rank_priority$expression_DTW_rank,
  ")",
  collapse = "; "
)

top_rho_other <- prioritization_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(!retrospective_reference) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(rho_rank) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  dplyr::pull(display_cluster) %>%
  paste(collapse = ", ")
top_phase_other <- prioritization_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(!retrospective_reference) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(phase_DTW_rank) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  dplyr::pull(display_cluster) %>%

top_expression_other <- prioritization_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(!retrospective_reference) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(expression_DTW_rank) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  dplyr::pull(display_cluster) %>%
  paste(collapse = ", ")

candidate_summary_table <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c("rho absolute delta", "phase DTW", "expression CellAlign"),
  top_three_other_clusters = c(top_rho_other, top_phase_other, top_expression_other),
  predefined_reference_ranks = reference_rank_text,
  reference_in_top5 = c(
    any(reference_rank_priority$rho_rank <= 5L),
    any(reference_rank_priority$phase_DTW_rank <= 5L),
    any(reference_rank_priority$expression_DTW_rank <= 5L)
  ),
  principal_limit = c(
    "sample-level rho is noisy near n_cell = 3; saved BH FDR values are retained without interpreting ns as equivalence",
    "pooled-cell distribution; 24-bin boundary/rotation sensitivity; no stable rank CI with two repeats per time",
    "common 12-gene panel is comparable but includes six phase seeds; seed-exclusive rank unavailable"
  )
)

summary_lines <- c(
  "GSE157504 LD/DD cell-type prioritization audit",
  paste0("Predefined retrospective reference ranks: ", reference_rank_text, "."),

  ),

    ),

    ". Circular-shift ranks are reported separately."
  ),
  paste0(

  ),
  paste0(

All rho tests are non-significant; rho and phase DTW share the same inferred phases; CellAlign is seed-inclusive. These results support prioritization and interpretation, not a new major biological discovery or an independent validation claim."

readr::write_csv(
```

The candidate summary is generated from the saved outputs and the official Supplementary file 1. It reports contradictions, sparse coverage and unavailable comparisons without changing thresholds to favor the three reference cases. The completed analysis is retained as a conservative prioritization and interpretability result; no additional discovery analysis is required for that stated scope.

# 37. Display cluster 12 (author cluster 15) gene-level exploratory validation contract

Display cluster `12:DN1p_CNMa` (original author cluster `15:DN1p_CNMa`) is retained because it ranks first for both absolute rho change and phase-distribution DTW. These two quantities use the same predicted cell phases and are not independent validation. The saved rho comparison has FDR 0.846, so this is an exploratory prioritization result rather than evidence that LD and DD differ.

The gene panel is fixed before inspecting the new observed-expression curves. It contains exact-symbol `dpr8`, requested as the hypothesis-led candidate, plus the three non-seed genes with the smallest worse-condition author JTK BH value among genes listed as high-confidence cyclers in both LD and DD for cluster 15. The normalized Supplementary file 1 table was generated directly from the local Ma et al. workbook in section 35.

```{r cluster15-input-selection, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

cluster15_dir <- file.path(priority_dir, "cluster15_gene_validation")
cluster15_qa_dir <- file.path(cluster15_dir, "qa")
dir.create(cluster15_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(cluster15_qa_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cluster15_name <- "15:DN1p_CNMa"
cluster15_display <- clock_display_map$display_label[
  match(cluster15_name, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
]
phase_seed_genes <- c("per", "tim", "vri", "Pdp1", "Clk", "cwo")

count_cluster15 <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_raw_qc.rds"))
meta_cluster15_all <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
published_supp1_cluster15 <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(priority_dir, "published_supp1_rhythmic_gene_list.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(author_cluster == cluster15_name)
priority_cluster15 <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(priority_dir, "prioritization_comparison_17_clusters.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(author_cluster == cluster15_name)

cluster15_dual_condition_nonseed <- published_supp1_cluster15 %>%
  dplyr::filter(!gene %in% phase_seed_genes) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(condition) == 2L) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    published_LD_rhythmic = any(condition == "LD" & published_cycler == "HC_cycler"),
    published_DD_rhythmic = any(condition == "DD" & published_cycler == "HC_cycler"),
    worse_condition_JTK_BH = max(published_JTK_BH),

cluster15_plot_genes <- unique(c("dpr8", cluster15_top_published))

cluster15_gene_selection <- cluster15_dual_condition_nonseed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    exact_count_symbol = gene %in% rownames(count_cluster15),
    selected_for_plot = gene %in% cluster15_plot_genes,
    selection_basis = dplyr::case_when(
      gene == "dpr8" ~ "hypothesis-led exact-symbol candidate; author HC_cycler in LD and DD",
      gene %in% cluster15_top_published ~
        "top three by the worse-condition author JTK BH value among dual-condition non-seed HC cyclers",
      TRUE ~ "meets dual-condition non-seed author criterion but is not in the compact plotted panel"
    )
  )

dpr8_author_check <- published_supp1_cluster15 %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene == "dpr8") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD")))

panel_I_fit_saved <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(panel_dir, "Panel_I_fit_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
cluster15_srb_fit_available <- any(
  panel_I_fit_saved$author_cluster == cluster15_name
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(priority_cluster15) == 1L,
  identical(cluster15_plot_genes, c("dpr8", "CG45263", "Proc", "Argk")),
  nrow(dpr8_author_check) == 2L,
  setequal(dpr8_author_check$condition, c("LD", "DD")),
  all(dpr8_author_check$published_cycler == "HC_cycler"),
  "dpr8" %in% rownames(count_cluster15),
  !"Dpr8" %in% rownames(count_cluster15),
  all(cluster15_plot_genes %in% rownames(count_cluster15)),
  !cluster15_srb_fit_available
)

readr::write_csv(
```

The compact panel therefore contains `dpr8`, `CG45263`, `Proc` and `Argk`. The first is hypothesis-led; the other three are author-evidence anchors selected without using the shape or p value of the new curves. `dpr8` is not one of the six genes used to seed cell-phase inference.

# 38. Display cluster 12 biological-sample coverage and pseudobulk

```{r cluster15-coverage-pseudobulk, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
meta_cluster15 <- meta_cluster15_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(author_cluster == cluster15_name)

expected_biological_samples <- meta_cluster15_all %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    condition, time_num, biological_repeat, biological_sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(condition, time_num, biological_repeat)

plate_audit <- meta_cluster15_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    condition, time_num, biological_repeat, biological_sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_AR_plates = dplyr::n_distinct(plate_id),
    AR_plates = paste(sort(unique(plate_id)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster15_sample_counts <- meta_cluster15 %>%
  dplyr::count(
    condition, time_num, biological_repeat, biological_sample,
    name = "n_cluster15_cells"
  )

cluster15_sample_coverage <- expected_biological_samples %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cluster15_sample_counts,
    by = c("condition", "time_num", "biological_repeat", "biological_sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    plate_audit,
    by = c("condition", "time_num", "biological_repeat", "biological_sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_cluster15_cells = tidyr::replace_na(n_cluster15_cells, 0L),
    represented = n_cluster15_cells > 0L,
    replicate_unit = "biological_sample; AR plates are aggregated, not independent replicates"
  )

cluster15_time_coverage <- cluster15_sample_coverage %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition, time_num) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_expected_biological_samples = dplyr::n(),
    n_represented_biological_samples = sum(represented),
    total_cluster15_cells = sum(n_cluster15_cells),
    min_cells_in_represented_sample = min(
      n_cluster15_cells[n_cluster15_cells > 0L],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_cells_in_represented_sample = max(n_cluster15_cells),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    coverage_status = dplyr::if_else(
      n_represented_biological_samples == n_expected_biological_samples,
      "both biological samples represented",
      "one biological sample absent for cluster 15"
    )
  )

cluster15_sample_factor <- factor(
  meta_cluster15$biological_sample,
  levels = unique(meta_cluster15$biological_sample)
)
cluster15_design <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + cluster15_sample_factor)
colnames(cluster15_design) <- levels(cluster15_sample_factor)

cluster15_count_matrix <- count_cluster15[, meta_cluster15$cell, drop = FALSE]
cluster15_pseudobulk <- cluster15_count_matrix %*% cluster15_design
cluster15_library <- Matrix::colSums(cluster15_pseudobulk)
cluster15_gene_count <- as.matrix(
  cluster15_pseudobulk[cluster15_plot_genes, , drop = FALSE]
)
cluster15_log2_cpm <- log2(
  sweep(cluster15_gene_count, 2, cluster15_library, "/") * 1e6 + 1
)

cluster15_observed <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(cluster15_log2_cpm),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
names(cluster15_observed) <- c("gene", "biological_sample", "log2_cpm")

cluster15_observed_count <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(cluster15_gene_count),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
names(cluster15_observed_count) <- c(
  "gene", "biological_sample", "pseudobulk_count"
)

cluster15_observed <- cluster15_observed %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cluster15_observed_count,
    by = c("gene", "biological_sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cluster15_sample_coverage %>% dplyr::filter(represented),
    by = "biological_sample"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene = factor(gene, levels = cluster15_plot_genes),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, condition, time_num) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(biological_repeat, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    point_time = time_num + if (dplyr::n() == 1L) {
      0
    } else {
      seq(-0.14, 0.14, length.out = dplyr::n())
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

stopifnot(
  nrow(cluster15_sample_coverage) == 24L,
  sum(cluster15_sample_coverage$represented) == 21L,
  all(cluster15_library > 0),
  nrow(cluster15_observed) == length(cluster15_plot_genes) * 21L
)

readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_sample_coverage,
  file.path(cluster15_dir, "cluster15_sample_coverage.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_time_coverage,
  file.path(cluster15_dir, "cluster15_timepoint_coverage.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_observed,
  file.path(cluster15_dir, "cluster15_observed_pseudobulk_points.csv")
)
```

Pseudobulk is the sum of raw RNA counts within display cluster 12 (author cluster 15) and one actual biological sample, divided by that cluster-sample library size and transformed as `log2(CPM + 1)`. AR plates contributing to the same biological sample are aggregated. Samples with no cell from this subgroup cannot yield a pseudobulk point and remain visible in the coverage tables as zero-cell missing observations.

# 39. Descriptive 24 h observed-time fits

```{r cluster15-observed-harmonic-fit, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cluster15_fit_groups <- cluster15_observed %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, condition) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(gene, condition)

cluster15_curve_list <- vector("list", nrow(cluster15_fit_groups))
cluster15_diagnostic_list <- vector("list", nrow(cluster15_fit_groups))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cluster15_fit_groups))) {
  gene_now <- as.character(cluster15_fit_groups$gene[i])
  condition_now <- as.character(cluster15_fit_groups$condition[i])
  observed_now <- cluster15_observed %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene == gene_now,
      condition == condition_now
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
      cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
    )

  harmonic_fit <- stats::lm(log2_cpm ~ sin24 + cos24, data = observed_now)
  harmonic_null <- stats::lm(log2_cpm ~ 1, data = observed_now)
  harmonic_test <- stats::anova(harmonic_null, harmonic_fit)
  fit_coef <- stats::coef(harmonic_fit)

  curve_grid <- tibble::tibble(
    time_num = seq(0, 24, length.out = 241),
    sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
    cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
  )
  curve_prediction <- as.data.frame(stats::predict(
    harmonic_fit,
    newdata = curve_grid,
    interval = "confidence",
    level = 0.95
  ))

  ci_supported <- nrow(observed_now) >= 8L &&
    dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num) == 6L &&
    stats::df.residual(harmonic_fit) >= 5L &&
    harmonic_fit$rank == 3L &&
    all(is.finite(as.matrix(curve_prediction)))

  cluster15_curve_list[[i]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    curve_grid,
    curve_prediction
  ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene = gene_now,
      condition = factor(condition_now, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
      time_num,
      fitted_log2_cpm = fit,
      ci_low = lwr,
      ci_high = upr,
      draw_ci = ci_supported
    )

  cluster15_diagnostic_list[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    gene = gene_now,
    condition = condition_now,
    n_biological_samples = nrow(observed_now),
    n_timepoints = dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num),
    n_timepoints_with_two_samples = sum(
      table(observed_now$time_num) == 2L
    ),
    residual_df = stats::df.residual(harmonic_fit),
    model_rank = harmonic_fit$rank,
    r_squared = summary(harmonic_fit)$r.squared,
    harmonic_model_p = harmonic_test$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    amplitude_log2_cpm = sqrt(
      fit_coef[["cos24"]]^2 + fit_coef[["sin24"]]^2
    ),
    peak_time_hours = (
      atan2(fit_coef[["sin24"]], fit_coef[["cos24"]]) %% (2 * pi)
    ) * 24 / (2 * pi),
    interval = dplyr::if_else(
      ci_supported,
      "pointwise 95% confidence interval for the fitted mean",
      "not drawn: sample/time/model diagnostics did not pass"
    ),
    interpretation = "descriptive 24 h biological-sample observed-time LM; not an SRB fit"
  )
}

cluster15_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(cluster15_curve_list)
cluster15_fit_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(cluster15_diagnostic_list)

readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_curves,
  file.path(cluster15_dir, "cluster15_observed_harmonic_curves.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_fit_diagnostics,
  file.path(cluster15_dir, "cluster15_observed_harmonic_diagnostics.csv")
)
```

The bands are pointwise 95% confidence intervals for the fitted mean from a sample-level linear model with sine and cosine terms. They are shown only after the recorded sample, time-point, residual-degree-of-freedom and rank checks pass. They are conditional model intervals, not SRB uncertainty, not simultaneous bands and not a test of an LD/DD difference.

# 40. Display cluster 12 continuous gene curves

```{r cluster15-observed-gene-figures, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8.6, fig.height=11.5}
cluster15_fill <- c("LD" = "#D8EADE", "DD" = "#D5CAE3")
cluster15_line <- c("LD" = "#548E72", "DD" = "#8A70A5")
cluster15_time_breaks <- c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)

make_cluster15_observed_plot <- function(gene_now) {
  observed_now <- cluster15_observed %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_now)
  curve_now <- cluster15_curves %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_now)

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = curve_now %>% dplyr::filter(draw_ci),
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = time_num, ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high,
        fill = condition, group = condition
      ),
      alpha = 0.46,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(

    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
```

The plotted genes are all supported by the authors' rhythmic list in both conditions, but the present analysis does not show that any gene changed between LD and DD. The saved display-cluster-12-specific SRB gene model is absent, so SRB FDR and SRB predicted-phase curves remain explicitly unavailable. For the present descriptive scope, the existing results are complete and are retained as candidate directions rather than a new condition-effect claim.

# 42. Display cluster 12 versus display cluster 1 gene-level comparison contract

The comparison below uses only saved raw counts and sample metadata. It does not rerun Seurat integration, cell-phase inference or SRB gene-parameter fitting. The four exact count-matrix symbols are `dpr8`, `CG45263`, `Proc` and `Argk`. The requested `ArgK` label is therefore shown as its data-supported symbol `Argk`.

No saved cluster-specific SRB fit exists for these four genes in either display cluster `12:DN1p_CNMa` (author 15) or display cluster `1:DN1p_CNMa` (author 1). Consequently, no SRB amplitude, phase, FDR or SRB confidence interval is plotted. This absence is written to a machine-readable audit table before the observed-expression comparison is generated.

```{r cluster15-cluster1-input-audit, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

comparison_validation_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/GSE157504_validation"
comparison_out_dir <- file.path(comparison_validation_dir, "result_LD_DD")
comparison_priority_dir <- file.path(
  comparison_out_dir,
  "prioritization_validation"
)
cluster15_cluster1_dir <- file.path(
  comparison_priority_dir,
  "cluster15_cluster1_gene_comparison"
)
cluster15_cluster1_qa_dir <- file.path(cluster15_cluster1_dir, "qa")
dir.create(cluster15_cluster1_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(cluster15_cluster1_qa_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

comparison_genes <- c("dpr8", "CG45263", "Proc", "Argk")
comparison_clusters <- c("15:DN1p_CNMa", "1:DN1p_CNMa")
comparison_conditions <- c("LD", "DD")
comparison_display <- stats::setNames(
  clock_display_map$display_label[
    match(comparison_clusters, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
  ],
  comparison_clusters
)

comparison_counts <- readRDS(file.path(
  comparison_out_dir,
  "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_raw_qc.rds"
))
comparison_metadata <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(comparison_out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = clock_display_map$display_label[
      match(author_cluster, clock_display_map$author_original_label)
    ]
  )
comparison_panel_I <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(comparison_out_dir, "panels_EI", "Panel_I_fit_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
comparison_LD_gene_param <- readRDS(file.path(
  comparison_out_dir,
  "GSE157504_LD_author17_gene_param.rds"
))

stopifnot(
  all(comparison_genes %in% rownames(comparison_counts)),
  all(comparison_clusters %in% comparison_metadata$author_cluster),
  identical(
    unique(comparison_LD_gene_param$param_long$phase_stratum),
    "LD_author17"
  )
)

cluster_specific_SRB_matches <- comparison_panel_I %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene %in% comparison_genes,
    author_cluster %in% comparison_clusters
  )

cluster15_cluster1_SRB_audit <- tidyr::crossing(
  gene = comparison_genes,
  author_cluster = comparison_clusters,
  condition = comparison_conditions
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cluster_specific_SRB_matches %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene, author_cluster, condition,
        SRB_Amplitude = Amplitude,
        SRB_Phase = Phase,

      ),

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_cluster = unname(comparison_display[author_cluster]),

    action = dplyr::if_else(
      cluster_specific_SRB_available,

      )

stopifnot(
  nrow(cluster_specific_SRB_matches) == 0L,
  !any(cluster15_cluster1_SRB_audit$cluster_specific_SRB_available)
)

readr::write_csv(
```

# 43. Biological-sample pseudobulk for both CNMa subgroups

For each cluster and biological sample, raw RNA counts are summed across the cells assigned to that cluster. The library denominator is the total cluster-by-sample RNA count across all genes, followed by `log2(CPM + 1)`. AR plates that belong to the same biological sample are aggregated and are not treated as replicates. A missing point means that the cluster has no cell in that biological sample; it is not imputed.

```{r cluster15-cluster1-pseudobulk, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
comparison_expected_samples <- comparison_metadata %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    condition, time_num, biological_repeat, biological_sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(condition, comparison_conditions),
    time_num,
    biological_repeat
  )

comparison_metadata_subset <- comparison_metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(author_cluster %in% comparison_clusters)

comparison_cluster_sample_counts <- comparison_metadata_subset %>%
  dplyr::count(
    author_cluster, condition, time_num,
    biological_repeat, biological_sample,
    name = "n_cluster_cells"
  )

cluster15_cluster1_coverage <- tidyr::crossing(
  author_cluster = comparison_clusters,
  comparison_expected_samples
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    comparison_cluster_sample_counts,
    by = c(
      "author_cluster", "condition", "time_num",
      "biological_repeat", "biological_sample"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_cluster_cells = tidyr::replace_na(n_cluster_cells, 0L),
    display_cluster = unname(comparison_display[author_cluster]),
    represented = n_cluster_cells > 0L,
    replicate_unit = paste0(
      "biological_sample; AR plates aggregated within sample; ",
      "zero-cell cluster-samples are missing, not imputed"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(author_cluster, comparison_clusters),
    match(condition, comparison_conditions),
    time_num,
    biological_repeat
  )

comparison_pseudobulk_list <- vector(
  "list",
  length(comparison_clusters)
)

for (i in seq_along(comparison_clusters)) {
  cluster_now <- comparison_clusters[i]
  metadata_now <- comparison_metadata_subset %>%
    dplyr::filter(author_cluster == cluster_now)
  sample_factor_now <- factor(
    metadata_now$biological_sample,
    levels = unique(metadata_now$biological_sample)
  )
  design_now <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + sample_factor_now)
  colnames(design_now) <- levels(sample_factor_now)

  pseudobulk_now <- comparison_counts[
    , metadata_now$cell, drop = FALSE
  ] %*% design_now
  library_now <- Matrix::colSums(pseudobulk_now)
  gene_count_now <- as.matrix(
    pseudobulk_now[comparison_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  log2_cpm_now <- log2(
    sweep(gene_count_now, 2, library_now, "/") * 1e6 + 1
  )

  observed_now <- as.data.frame(
    as.table(log2_cpm_now),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(observed_now) <- c("gene", "biological_sample", "log2_cpm")

  count_now <- as.data.frame(
    as.table(gene_count_now),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(count_now) <- c(
    "gene", "biological_sample", "pseudobulk_count"
  )

  comparison_pseudobulk_list[[i]] <- observed_now %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      count_now,
      by = c("gene", "biological_sample")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(author_cluster = cluster_now) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      cluster15_cluster1_coverage %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          author_cluster == cluster_now,
          represented
        ),
      by = c("biological_sample", "author_cluster")
    )
}

cluster15_cluster1_observed <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  comparison_pseudobulk_list
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene = factor(gene, levels = comparison_genes),
    author_cluster = factor(
      author_cluster,
      levels = comparison_clusters
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = comparison_conditions),
    display_cluster = factor(
      unname(comparison_display[as.character(author_cluster)]),
      levels = unname(comparison_display[comparison_clusters])
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    gene, author_cluster, condition, time_num
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(biological_repeat, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    point_time = time_num + if (dplyr::n() == 1L) {
      0
    } else {
      seq(-0.14, 0.14, length.out = dplyr::n())
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cluster15_cluster1_detection <- cluster15_cluster1_observed %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, author_cluster, display_cluster, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_represented_biological_samples = dplyr::n(),
    n_timepoints = dplyr::n_distinct(time_num),
    n_samples_with_positive_count = sum(pseudobulk_count > 0),
    total_gene_count = sum(pseudobulk_count),
    min_cluster_cells = min(n_cluster_cells),
    max_cluster_cells = max(n_cluster_cells),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    detection_status = dplyr::case_when(
      n_represented_biological_samples == 0L ~
        "cluster absent from all biological samples",
      total_gene_count == 0 ~
        "gene not detected in represented cluster-samples",
      TRUE ~ "observed-expression comparison supported"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(gene, comparison_genes),
    match(author_cluster, comparison_clusters),
    match(condition, comparison_conditions)
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(cluster15_cluster1_observed) ==
    length(comparison_genes) * sum(cluster15_cluster1_coverage$represented),
  all(cluster15_cluster1_detection$total_gene_count > 0),
  all(cluster15_cluster1_detection$n_timepoints == 6L)
)

readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_cluster1_coverage,
  file.path(cluster15_cluster1_dir, "cluster15_cluster1_sample_coverage.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_cluster1_observed,
  file.path(cluster15_cluster1_dir, "cluster15_cluster1_observed_points.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  cluster15_cluster1_detection,
  file.path(cluster15_cluster1_dir, "cluster15_cluster1_gene_detection.csv")
)
```

# 44. Descriptive 24 h fits and uncertainty audit

Each curve is a separate sample-level linear model with sine and cosine terms for one gene, cluster and condition. A pointwise 95% confidence band for the fitted mean is drawn only when at least eight biological samples, all six sampling times, at least five residual degrees of freedom, a full-rank model and finite predictions are available. These are descriptive observed-time fits, not SRB fits, not simultaneous bands and not LD/DD contrast tests.

```{r cluster15-cluster1-harmonic-fit, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
comparison_fit_groups <- cluster15_cluster1_observed %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, author_cluster, condition) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(gene, comparison_genes),
    match(author_cluster, comparison_clusters),
    match(condition, comparison_conditions)
  )

comparison_curve_list <- vector("list", nrow(comparison_fit_groups))
comparison_diagnostic_list <- vector("list", nrow(comparison_fit_groups))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(comparison_fit_groups))) {
  gene_now <- as.character(comparison_fit_groups$gene[i])
  cluster_now <- as.character(comparison_fit_groups$author_cluster[i])
  condition_now <- as.character(comparison_fit_groups$condition[i])

  observed_now <- cluster15_cluster1_observed %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene == gene_now,
      author_cluster == cluster_now,
      condition == condition_now
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
      cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
    )

  harmonic_fit_now <- stats::lm(
    log2_cpm ~ sin24 + cos24,
    data = observed_now
  )
  harmonic_null_now <- stats::lm(log2_cpm ~ 1, data = observed_now)
  harmonic_test_now <- stats::anova(
    harmonic_null_now,
    harmonic_fit_now
  )
  coefficient_now <- stats::coef(harmonic_fit_now)

  grid_now <- tibble::tibble(
    time_num = seq(0, 24, length.out = 241),
    sin24 = sin(2 * pi * time_num / 24),
    cos24 = cos(2 * pi * time_num / 24)
  )
  prediction_now <- as.data.frame(stats::predict(
    harmonic_fit_now,
    newdata = grid_now,
    interval = "confidence",
    level = 0.95
  ))

  ci_supported_now <- nrow(observed_now) >= 8L &&
    dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num) == 6L &&
    stats::df.residual(harmonic_fit_now) >= 5L &&
    harmonic_fit_now$rank == 3L &&
    all(is.finite(as.matrix(prediction_now)))

  comparison_curve_list[[i]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    grid_now,
    prediction_now
  ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene = gene_now,
      author_cluster = cluster_now,
      display_cluster = unname(comparison_display[cluster_now]),
      condition = condition_now,
      time_num,
      fitted_log2_cpm = fit,
      ci_low = lwr,
      ci_high = upr,
      draw_ci = ci_supported_now,
      interval_definition = dplyr::if_else(
        ci_supported_now,
        "pointwise 95% confidence interval for the fitted mean",
        "not drawn because the prespecified diagnostics did not pass"
      )
    )

  comparison_diagnostic_list[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    gene = gene_now,
    author_cluster = cluster_now,
    display_cluster = unname(comparison_display[cluster_now]),
    condition = condition_now,
    n_biological_samples = nrow(observed_now),
    n_timepoints = dplyr::n_distinct(observed_now$time_num),
    n_timepoints_with_two_samples = sum(
      table(observed_now$time_num) == 2L
    ),
    residual_df = stats::df.residual(harmonic_fit_now),
    model_rank = harmonic_fit_now$rank,
    r_squared = summary(harmonic_fit_now)$r.squared,
    descriptive_harmonic_p = harmonic_test_now$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    observed_harmonic_amplitude_log2cpm = sqrt(
      coefficient_now[["cos24"]]^2 +
        coefficient_now[["sin24"]]^2
    ),
    observed_harmonic_peak_time_hours = (
      atan2(
        coefficient_now[["sin24"]],
        coefficient_now[["cos24"]]
      ) %% (2 * pi)
    ) * 24 / (2 * pi),
    ci_supported = ci_supported_now,
    interpretation = paste0(
      "descriptive biological-sample observed-time harmonic LM; ",
      "not an SRB fit and not an LD/DD difference test"
    )
  )
}

cluster15_cluster1_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  comparison_curve_list
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene = factor(gene, levels = comparison_genes),
    author_cluster = factor(
      author_cluster,
      levels = comparison_clusters
    ),
    display_cluster = factor(

      levels = unname(comparison_display[comparison_clusters])
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = comparison_conditions)
  )

cluster15_cluster1_fit_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(

) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(gene, comparison_genes),
    match(author_cluster, comparison_clusters),
    match(condition, comparison_conditions)
  )

stopifnot(
```

# 45. Compact comparison and cluster 15 figures

```{r cluster15-cluster1-gene-figures, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=9.2, fig.height=16}
comparison_fill <- c("LD" = "#D8EADE", "DD" = "#D5CAE3")
comparison_line <- c("LD" = "#548E72", "DD" = "#8A70A5")
comparison_time_breaks <- c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)

comparison_y_limits <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cluster15_cluster1_observed %>%
    dplyr::transmute(gene, value = log2_cpm),
  cluster15_cluster1_curves %>%
    dplyr::transmute(gene, value = ci_low),
  cluster15_cluster1_curves %>%
    dplyr::transmute(gene, value = ci_high)
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    y_min_raw = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_max_raw = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_padding = pmax(0.35, 0.06 * (y_max_raw - y_min_raw)),
    y_min = pmax(0, y_min_raw - y_padding),
    y_max = y_max_raw + y_padding
  )

make_CNMa_comparison_panel <- function(
  gene_now,
  cluster_now,
  show_x = TRUE,
  show_y = TRUE,
  show_cluster_label = TRUE
) {
  observed_now <- cluster15_cluster1_observed %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene == gene_now,
      author_cluster == cluster_now
    )
  curve_now <- cluster15_cluster1_curves %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene == gene_now,
      author_cluster == cluster_now
    )
  y_limit_now <- comparison_y_limits %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_now)
  display_now <- unname(comparison_display[cluster_now])

  plot_now <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = curve_now %>% dplyr::filter(draw_ci),
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = time_num,
        ymin = ci_low,
        ymax = ci_high,
        fill = condition,
        group = condition
      ),
      alpha = 0.46,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = curve_now,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = time_num,
        y = fitted_log2_cpm,
        colour = condition,
        group = condition
      ),
      linewidth = 1.45,
      lineend = "round",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = observed_now,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = point_time,
        y = log2_cpm,
        colour = condition,
        fill = condition
      ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.5,
      stroke = 1.05
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = comparison_line,
      breaks = comparison_conditions,
      labels = c("LD", "DD (CT)"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = comparison_fill,
      breaks = comparison_conditions,
      labels = c("LD", "DD (CT)"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 24),
      breaks = comparison_time_breaks,
      labels = sprintf("%02d", comparison_time_breaks),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_limit_now$y_min, y_limit_now$y_max),
      clip = "on"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = gene_now,
      x = if (show_x) "ZT" else NULL,
      y = if (show_y) "log2(CPM + 1)" else NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          shape = 16,
          size = 4.6,
          stroke = 0,
          alpha = 1,
          linetype = 0
        )
      ),
      fill = "none"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 16,
      base_family = "Helvetica"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 29,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 5)
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, colour = "#222222"),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(
        linewidth = 0.75,
        colour = "#222222"
      ),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(
        linewidth = 0.75,
        colour = "#222222"
      ),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.13, "cm"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.8, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.55, "cm"),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(6, 8, 6, 8)
    )

  if (!show_x) {
    plot_now <- plot_now +
      ggplot2::theme(
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank()
      )
  }
  if (!show_y) {
    plot_now <- plot_now +
      ggplot2::theme(
        axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank()
      )
  }
  if (show_cluster_label) {
    plot_now <- plot_now +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0.55,
        y = y_limit_now$y_max,
        label = display_now,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1.35,
        size = 5.4,
        fontface = "bold",
        family = "Helvetica",
        colour = "#333333"
      )
  }

  plot_now
}

      cluster_now = cluster_now,
      show_x = gene_now == tail(comparison_genes, 1),
      show_y = cluster_now == comparison_clusters[1],
      show_cluster_label = TRUE
    )
  }
}
```


The comparison is supported for all four genes in both CNMa subgroups and both conditions: every group contains all six sampling times, and every gene has positive counts in the represented cluster-samples. Display cluster 12 (author 15) has 21 represented biological-sample combinations, whereas display cluster 1 (author 1) has all 24; the three absent display-cluster-12 samples remain explicit in the coverage CSV. The curves provide exploratory directions, particularly for `Proc` and `CG45263`, but do not establish a condition-dependent amplitude or phase change or an independently validated new biological finding. No further discovery analysis is required for the current descriptive claim scope.

# 47. Figure 6 I/J: display cluster 12 (author cluster 15) SRB input and inference-mode audit

This appended analysis supersedes the earlier statement that no cluster-specific SRB fit is available once the fit chunk below has been run. Display cluster `12:DN1p_CNMa` is always original author cluster `15:DN1p_CNMa`; it is never relabelled as author cluster 1. The four genes remain fixed from the pre-fit author high-confidence dual-condition list: `dpr8`, `CG45263`, `Proc` and `Argk`.

The current data contain 9 represented LD and 12 represented DD biological samples for author cluster 15. Although both strata exceed the six-sample minimum, LD ZT2, ZT18 and ZT22 each contain only one represented biological sample. The current `infer_gene_param()` requires at least two independent samples in every `sample_boot_by` level within every fitting stratum. Therefore the joint LD/DD fit below is deliberately cell-level and must not be described as sample-aware. Biological-sample and one-cell-sample diagnostics remain attached to every reported fit.

```{r figure6-author15-srb-input-audit, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

figure6_validation_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/GSE157504_validation"
figure6_out_dir <- file.path(figure6_validation_dir, "result_LD_DD")
figure6_panel_dir <- file.path(figure6_out_dir, "panels_EI")
figure6_srb_dir <- file.path(
  figure6_out_dir,
  "figure6_IJ_author15_SRB_raw_20261024"
)
figure6_srb_qa_dir <- file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "qa")
dir.create(figure6_srb_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure6_srb_qa_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

figure6_package_dir <- "/path/to/scRhythmBayes"
figure6_infer_file <- file.path(figure6_package_dir, "R/infer_gene_param.R")
stopifnot(file.exists(figure6_infer_file))
source(figure6_infer_file)

figure6_function_args <- names(formals(infer_gene_param))
stopifnot(all(c("sample_by", "sample_boot_by") %in% figure6_function_args))

figure6_function_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  source_file = figure6_infer_file,
  source_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(figure6_infer_file)),
  source_modified = as.character(file.info(figure6_infer_file)$mtime),
  supports_sample_by = "sample_by" %in% figure6_function_args,
  supports_sample_boot_by = "sample_boot_by" %in% figure6_function_args
)

figure6_clock_map <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(figure6_out_dir, "clock_neuron_display_id_mapping.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
figure6_count <- readRDS(file.path(
  figure6_out_dir,
  "GSE157504_LD_DD_count_raw_qc.rds"
))
figure6_meta <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(figure6_out_dir, "GSE157504_LD_DD_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
figure6_phase <- readRDS(file.path(
  figure6_out_dir,
  "GSE157504_LD_DD_author17_phase.rds"
))

figure6_author15 <- "15:DN1p_CNMa"
figure6_author15_display <- figure6_clock_map$display_label[
  match(figure6_author15, figure6_clock_map$author_original_label)
]
figure6_candidate_genes <- c("dpr8", "CG45263", "Proc", "Argk")

stopifnot(
  identical(figure6_author15_display, "12:DN1p_CNMa"),
  all(figure6_candidate_genes %in% rownames(figure6_count)),
  all(c("cell", "theta_pred", "r_cell") %in% names(figure6_phase)),
  !anyDuplicated(figure6_meta$cell),
  !anyDuplicated(figure6_phase$cell)
)

figure6_author15_meta <- figure6_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(author_cluster == figure6_author15) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_stratum = paste(condition, author_cluster, sep = " | ")
  )
figure6_author15_count <- figure6_count[
  , figure6_author15_meta$cell, drop = FALSE
]
figure6_author15_phase_idx <- match(
  figure6_author15_meta$cell,
  figure6_phase$cell
)
figure6_author15_theta <- figure6_phase$theta_pred[
  figure6_author15_phase_idx
]
figure6_author15_r <- figure6_phase$r_cell[
  figure6_author15_phase_idx
]

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(figure6_author15_phase_idx),
  identical(colnames(figure6_author15_count), figure6_author15_meta$cell),
  all(is.finite(figure6_author15_theta)),
  all(is.finite(figure6_author15_r)),
  setequal(unique(figure6_author15_meta$condition), c("LD", "DD"))
)

figure6_expected_samples <- figure6_meta %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    condition, time_num, biological_repeat, biological_sample
  )
figure6_author15_sample_cells <- figure6_author15_meta %>%
  dplyr::count(
    condition, time_num, biological_repeat, biological_sample,
    name = "n_author15_cells"
  )
figure6_author15_sample_coverage <- figure6_expected_samples %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    figure6_author15_sample_cells,
    by = c(
      "condition", "time_num", "biological_repeat",
      "biological_sample"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_author15_cells = tidyr::replace_na(n_author15_cells, 0L),
    represented = n_author15_cells > 0L
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(condition, time_num, biological_repeat)

figure6_author15_bin_coverage <- figure6_author15_sample_coverage %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition, time_num) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_expected_samples = dplyr::n(),
    n_represented_samples = sum(represented),
    n_cells = sum(n_author15_cells),
    n_one_cell_samples = sum(n_author15_cells == 1L),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
figure6_author15_group_coverage <- figure6_author15_sample_coverage %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_expected_samples = dplyr::n(),
    n_represented_samples = sum(represented),
    n_time_bins = dplyr::n_distinct(time_num[represented]),
    min_samples_per_time_bin = min(
      figure6_author15_bin_coverage$n_represented_samples[
        figure6_author15_bin_coverage$condition == dplyr::first(condition)
      ]
    ),
    n_cells = sum(n_author15_cells),
    n_one_cell_samples = sum(n_author15_cells == 1L),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

figure6_sample_aware_eligible <-
  all(figure6_author15_group_coverage$n_represented_samples >= 6L) &&
  all(figure6_author15_bin_coverage$n_represented_samples >= 2L)

figure6_inference_audit <- figure6_author15_group_coverage %>%

    sample_boot_by_used = NA_character_,

      "sample-aware disabled for the joint fit because at least one ",
      "condition-by-time bin has fewer than two represented samples"
    )
  )

stopifnot(
```
