# 48. Figure 6 J: author cluster 15 all-gene fit and four fixed candidates

The fit uses every gene in the matched author-cluster-15 raw-count matrix so that BH FDR is calculated over the full eligible-gene universe within each LD/DD stratum. Candidate selection remains independent of the new fit. The plotted curve is the unshrunk SRB harmonic at unit size factor, exactly `exp(Mesor + beta1_est * cos(theta) + beta2_est * sin(theta))`; `beta1_shrunk`, `beta2_shrunk`, `Amplitude_shrunk` and `Phase_shrunk` are not used.

```{r figure6-author15-srb-fit, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
figure6_author15_param_path <- file.path(
  figure6_srb_dir,
  "GSE157504_author15_LD_DD_gene_param_raw_20261024.rds"
)
figure6_fit_worker <- min(
  4L,
  max(1L, future::availableCores() - 2L)
)

if (file.exists(figure6_author15_param_path)) {
  figure6_author15_param <- readRDS(figure6_author15_param_path)
} else {
  figure6_author15_param <- infer_gene_param(
    count = figure6_author15_count,
    metadata = figure6_author15_meta,
    theta_pred = figure6_author15_theta,
    r_cell = figure6_author15_r,
    strata_by = "gene_stratum",
    ZT_by = "time_num",
    B = 100,
    n_worker = figure6_fit_worker,
    setseed = 1,
    Verbose = TRUE
  )
  saveRDS(figure6_author15_param, figure6_author15_param_path)
}

stopifnot(
  all(c(
    "param_long", "fit_diagnostics", "bootstrap_res",
    "gene_eligibility"
  ) %in% names(figure6_author15_param)),
  all(c(
    "gene", "gene_stratum", "Mesor", "Amplitude", "Phase", "FDR"
  ) %in% names(figure6_author15_param$param_long)),
  all(c(
    "gene", "gene_stratum", "beta1_est", "beta2_est", "feasible",
    "conv_code", "hessian_ok", "beta_bound_hit", "Hessian_status"
  ) %in% names(figure6_author15_param$fit_diagnostics)),
  all(figure6_candidate_genes %in% figure6_author15_param$param_long$gene),
  is.null(figure6_author15_param$inference)
)

readr::write_csv(
  figure6_author15_param$param_long,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "author15_gene_param_all_genes.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  figure6_author15_param$fit_diagnostics,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "author15_fit_diagnostics_all_genes.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  figure6_author15_param$bootstrap_res,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "author15_bootstrap_all_genes.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  figure6_author15_param$gene_eligibility,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "author15_gene_eligibility_all_genes.csv")
)

figure6_author15_boot <- figure6_author15_param$bootstrap_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% figure6_candidate_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene, gene_stratum,
    Amp_CI_low, Amp_CI_high,
    Phase_CI_low, Phase_CI_high,
    Bootstrap_valid_fraction
  )

figure6_author15_summary <- figure6_author15_param$param_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% figure6_candidate_genes) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    figure6_author15_param$fit_diagnostics %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene, gene_stratum,
        feasible, conv_code,
        beta1_est, beta2_est,
        beta1_se, beta2_se,
        hessian_ok, beta_bound_hit, Hessian_status
      ),
    by = c("gene", "gene_stratum")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    figure6_author15_boot,
    by = c("gene", "gene_stratum")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = sub(" \\|.*$", "", gene_stratum),
    author_cluster = figure6_author15,
    display_cluster = figure6_author15_display
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    figure6_candidate_detection,
    by = c("gene", "condition")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fit_reliable =
      !is.na(feasible) & feasible == 1 &
      !is.na(conv_code) & conv_code == 0 &
      !is.na(hessian_ok) & hessian_ok == 1 &
      !is.na(beta_bound_hit) & beta_bound_hit == 0 &
      is.finite(Mesor) & is.finite(beta1_est) & is.finite(beta2_est) &
      is.finite(Amplitude) & is.finite(Phase),
    Amplitude_report = ifelse(fit_reliable, Amplitude, NA_real_),
    Phase_report = ifelse(fit_reliable, Phase, NA_real_),
    FDR_report = ifelse(is.finite(FDR), FDR, NA_real_),
    Amp_CI_low_report = ifelse(
      fit_reliable & is.finite(Amp_CI_low),
      Amp_CI_low,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Amp_CI_high_report = ifelse(
      fit_reliable & is.finite(Amp_CI_high),
      Amp_CI_high,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Phase_CI_low_report = ifelse(
      fit_reliable & is.finite(Phase_CI_low),
      Phase_CI_low,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Phase_CI_high_report = ifelse(
      fit_reliable & is.finite(Phase_CI_high),
      Phase_CI_high,
      NA_real_
    ),
    parameter_status = dplyr::if_else(
      fit_reliable,
      "reliable unshrunk harmonic fit",
      "unavailable for main panel: raw-fit diagnostic gate not passed"
    ),
    CI_status = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(Amp_CI_low_report) & is.finite(Amp_CI_high_report) &
        is.finite(Phase_CI_low_report) & is.finite(Phase_CI_high_report),
      "available",
      "unavailable"
    ),
    inference_mode = "cell-level",
    FDR_scope = paste0(
      "BH across all eligible genes within the author15 ",
      "condition stratum; not sample-aware"
    ),
    condition_difference_test = "not performed"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(gene, figure6_candidate_genes),
    match(condition, c("LD", "DD"))
  )

readr::write_csv(
  figure6_author15_summary,
  file.path(
    figure6_srb_dir,
    "Panel_J_author15_candidate_raw_parameter_summary.csv"
  ),
  na = "unavailable"
)

figure6_fit_diagnostic_plot <- figure6_author15_summary %>%

  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = diagnostic_label),

    x = NULL,

    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Cell-level inference; samples are coverage diagnostics, ",

    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure6_srb_qa_dir, "Panel_J_author15_fit_diagnostics.png"),
  figure6_fit_diagnostic_plot,

ggplot2::ggsave(

  width = 7.2, height = 7.0, bg = "white"
)

stopifnot(any(figure6_author15_summary$fit_reliable))

figure6_theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 300)
figure6_author15_curve <- tidyr::crossing(
  figure6_author15_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(fit_reliable) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene, condition, author_cluster, display_cluster,
      Mesor, beta1_est, beta2_est

  theta = figure6_theta_grid
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fitted_expression = exp(
      Mesor + beta1_est * cos(theta) + beta2_est * sin(theta)
    ),
    gene = factor(gene, levels = figure6_candidate_genes),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD"))
  )

figure6_author15_labels <- figure6_author15_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(fit_reliable) %>%

    gene = factor(gene, levels = figure6_candidate_genes),

      condition,

        formatC(FDR_report, format = "g", digits = 2),
        "unavailable"
      ),
      "; n=", n_represented_biological_samples
    ),

  )
```

# 49. Figure 6 I/J aligned main-panel candidate

The replacement Figure 6 J candidate below groups the raw SRB gene curves in the same explicit cluster order required for Panels I and J: `2:s_LNv`, display `12:DN1p_CNMa` (author 15), and display `1:DN1p_CNMa` (author 1). It reuses the existing Panel I sample-aware fits for the s-LNv and author-1 genes, but reconstructs those curves from unshrunk `Mesor`, `beta1_est` and `beta2_est`. The new author-15 rows remain explicitly cell-level. These inference modes are recorded per row and are not pooled into a condition-difference test.

```{r figure6-IJ-aligned-raw-srb, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
figure6_cluster_order <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cluster_order, ~author_cluster, ~display_cluster,
  1L, "2:s_LNv", "2:s_LNv",

  3L, "1:DN1p_CNMa", "1:DN1p_CNMa"
)
stopifnot(identical(
  figure6_clock_map$display_label[
    match(
      figure6_cluster_order$author_cluster,
      figure6_clock_map$author_original_label
    )
  ],
  figure6_cluster_order$display_cluster
))

figure6_aligned_gene_manifest <- tibble::tribble(
  ~gene_order, ~gene, ~author_cluster,

  2L, "DIP-beta", "2:s_LNv",
  3L, "beat-Ic", "2:s_LNv",
  4L, "dpr8", "15:DN1p_CNMa",
  5L, "CG45263", "15:DN1p_CNMa",
  6L, "Proc", "15:DN1p_CNMa",
  7L, "Argk", "15:DN1p_CNMa",
  8L, "pdm3", "1:DN1p_CNMa",
  9L, "beat-Va", "1:DN1p_CNMa"
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(figure6_cluster_order, by = "author_cluster") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_order, gene_order)

    Phase_CI_low, Phase_CI_high,
    Bootstrap_valid_fraction,
    inference_mode,
    FDR_scope,
    source_result = basename(figure6_author15_param_path)
  )

figure6_cluster_coverage <- figure6_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    author_cluster %in% figure6_cluster_order$author_cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(author_cluster, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    n_represented_biological_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(
      biological_sample
    ),
    n_time_bins = dplyr::n_distinct(time_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

figure6_aligned_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  figure6_existing_raw,
  figure6_author15_raw
) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    figure6_aligned_gene_manifest,
    by = c("gene", "author_cluster")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    figure6_cluster_coverage,
    by = c("author_cluster", "condition")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fit_reliable =
      !is.na(feasible) & feasible == 1 &
      !is.na(conv_code) & conv_code == 0 &
      !is.na(hessian_ok) & hessian_ok == 1 &
      !is.na(beta_bound_hit) & beta_bound_hit == 0 &
      is.finite(Mesor) & is.finite(beta1_est) & is.finite(beta2_est) &
      is.finite(Amplitude) & is.finite(Phase),
    Amplitude_report = ifelse(fit_reliable, Amplitude, NA_real_),
    Phase_report = ifelse(fit_reliable, Phase, NA_real_),
    FDR_report = ifelse(is.finite(FDR), FDR, NA_real_),
    amplitude_CI_status = dplyr::if_else(
      fit_reliable & is.finite(Amp_CI_low) & is.finite(Amp_CI_high),
      "available",
      "unavailable"
    ),
    phase_CI_status = dplyr::if_else(
      fit_reliable & is.finite(Phase_CI_low) & is.finite(Phase_CI_high),
      "available",
      "unavailable"
    ),
    condition_difference_test = "not performed",
    curve_formula = paste0(
      "exp(Mesor + beta1_est*cos(theta) + beta2_est*sin(theta)); ",
      "unshrunk"
    ),
    panel_label = paste0(gene, "\n", display_cluster)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    cluster_order,
    gene_order,
    match(condition, c("LD", "DD"))
  )

readr::write_csv(
  figure6_aligned_gene_manifest,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "Panel_IJ_cluster_alignment_manifest.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  figure6_aligned_summary,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "Panel_J_aligned_raw_parameter_summary.csv"),
  na = "unavailable"
)

figure6_reliable_clusters <- unique(
  figure6_aligned_summary$author_cluster[
    figure6_aligned_summary$fit_reliable
  ]
)
stopifnot(all(
  figure6_cluster_order$author_cluster %in% figure6_reliable_clusters
))

figure6_aligned_curve <- tidyr::crossing(
  figure6_aligned_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(fit_reliable) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene, condition, author_cluster, display_cluster,
      cluster_order, gene_order, panel_label,
      inference_mode, Mesor, beta1_est, beta2_est
    ),
  theta = figure6_theta_grid
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fitted_expression = exp(
      Mesor + beta1_est * cos(theta) + beta2_est * sin(theta)
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
    panel_label = factor(
      panel_label,
      levels = unique(figure6_aligned_gene_manifest %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          panel_label = paste0(gene, "\n", display_cluster)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(panel_label))
    )
  )

figure6_aligned_labels <- figure6_aligned_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(fit_reliable) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("LD", "DD")),
    panel_label = factor(
      panel_label,
      levels = levels(figure6_aligned_curve$panel_label)
    ),
    label = paste0(
      condition,
      ": Amp=", formatC(Amplitude_report, format = "f", digits = 2),
      "; Phase=", formatC(Phase_report, format = "f", digits = 2),
      "; FDR=", ifelse(
        is.finite(FDR_report),
        formatC(FDR_report, format = "g", digits = 2),
        "unavailable"
      ),
      "; n=", n_represented_biological_samples,
      ifelse(inference_mode == "cell-level", "; cell-level", "; sample-aware")
    ),
    label_vjust = ifelse(condition == "LD", 1.1, 2.5)
  )

figure6_panel_J_aligned_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  figure6_aligned_curve,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = theta,
    y = fitted_expression,
    colour = condition
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = figure6_aligned_labels,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = label,
      colour = condition,
      vjust = label_vjust
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.02,
    size = 2.85,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~panel_label,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("LD" = "#548E72", "DD" = "#8A70A5"),
    breaks = c("LD", "DD"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
    breaks = c(0, pi, 2 * pi),
    labels = c("0", "pi", "2pi")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "SRB-predicted phase theta (rad)",
    y = "SRB expected count at size factor 1",
    title = "Figure 6J candidate: aligned raw SRB gene curves",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Cluster order: 2:s_LNv -> 12:DN1p_CNMa (author 15) -> ",
      "1:DN1p_CNMa (author 1); no LD/DD-difference test"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.55, "lines")
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure6_srb_dir,
    "Panel_J_aligned_three_cluster_raw_SRB_gene_column.png"
  ),
  figure6_panel_J_aligned_plot,
  width = 6.2, height = 20.0, dpi = 600, bg = "white"
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure6_srb_dir,
    "Panel_J_aligned_three_cluster_raw_SRB_gene_column.pdf"
  ),
  figure6_panel_J_aligned_plot,
  width = 6.2, height = 20.0, bg = "white"
)
readr::write_csv(
  figure6_aligned_curve,
  file.path(
    figure6_srb_dir,
    "Panel_J_aligned_three_cluster_raw_SRB_curve_points.csv"
  )
)

figure6_panel_J_aligned_plot
```

# 50. Figure 6 method boundaries and output contract

Panel F and Panel G remain different analyses: Panel F is CellAlign alignment of raw-count-derived gene-expression trajectories, whereas Panel G is DTW on 24-bin predicted cell-phase distributions. Neither result is a gene-level SRB fit. If display `14:DN2` (author cluster 19) remains in the CellAlign story, it is supplementary for the I/J logic because a corresponding cluster-specific Panel J SRB gene fit has not been validated here.

```{r figure6-IJ-output-contract, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
figure6_cluster_scope <- tibble::tribble(
  ~author_cluster, ~display_cluster, ~main_IJ_order, ~gene_level_SRB_status, ~figure_role,
  "2:s_LNv", "2:s_LNv", 1L,
  "existing sample-aware raw-parameter curves available",
  "main Panels I/J aligned reference",
  "15:DN1p_CNMa", "12:DN1p_CNMa", 2L,
  "new cell-level raw-parameter curves; sample-aware not allowed by time-bin coverage",
  "main Panels I/J aligned exploratory candidate",
  "1:DN1p_CNMa", "1:DN1p_CNMa", 3L,
  "existing sample-aware raw-parameter curves available",
  "main Panels I/J aligned reference",
  "19:DN2", "14:DN2", NA_integer_,
  "Panel J cluster-specific gene-level SRB not validated",
  "CellAlign may be retained in supplement; not a main Panel J SRB claim"
)

figure6_method_scope <- tibble::tribble(
  ~panel, ~method, ~input_unit, ~explicit_boundary,
  "F", "CellAlign gene-trajectory alignment",
  "raw-count-derived normalized expression trajectories within author cell type",
  "not phase-histogram DTW and not a gene-level SRB parameter fit",
  "G", "24-bin phase-distribution DTW",
  "predicted cell phases binned within author cell type and condition",
  "not CellAlign gene alignment and not a gene-level SRB parameter fit",
  "J", "scRhythmBayes gene-level harmonic fit",
  "matched raw-count cells with their theta_pred, r_cell, sample IDs and time_num",
  "LD and DD curves are descriptive separate fits; no direct condition-difference test"
)

figure6_output_contract <- tibble::tribble(
  ~output, ~format, ~content,
  "GSE157504_author15_LD_DD_gene_param_raw_20261024", "RDS",
  "complete author15 all-gene infer_gene_param result",
  "Panel_J_author15_candidate_raw_parameter_summary", "CSV",
  "Amplitude, phase, FDR, CI availability, effective samples and diagnostics for the four fixed genes",
  "Panel_J_author15_four_gene_raw_SRB_curves", "600 dpi PNG and vector PDF",
  "four-gene author15 diagnostic-gated unshrunk SRB curve column",
  "Panel_J_aligned_three_cluster_raw_SRB_gene_column", "600 dpi PNG and vector PDF",
  "main-panel candidate ordered as 2:s_LNv, display 12 author15, display 1 author1",
  "Panel_IJ_cluster_alignment_manifest", "CSV",
  "auditable author-ID, display-ID and gene order",
  "author15_sample_coverage_diagnostic", "600 dpi PNG and vector PDF",
  "biological-sample and time-bin eligibility audit",
  "Panel_J_author15_fit_diagnostics", "600 dpi PNG and vector PDF",
  "raw-fit reliability gate before main-panel inclusion"
)

readr::write_csv(
  figure6_cluster_scope,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "Figure6_IJ_cluster_scope.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  figure6_method_scope,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "Figure6_F_G_J_method_boundaries.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  figure6_output_contract,
  file.path(figure6_srb_dir, "Figure6_IJ_output_contract.csv")
)
writeLines(
  c(
    "Figure 6 I/J SRB boundary notes",
    "",
    "- Display 12:DN1p_CNMa is original author cluster 15:DN1p_CNMa.",

  ),

figure6_cluster_scope

```

The new Figure 6 J code does not use post-fit significance to choose genes, does not substitute shrunk coefficients for the requested raw harmonic, does not claim a direct LD/DD contrast, and does not call the author-15 result sample-aware. Run the appended chunks in order after confirming that the saved Section 12 raw counts, metadata and phase objects are present. The all-gene `infer_gene_param()` call is the only intentionally time-consuming step.

# 51. Saved-result parameter audit, independent gene plots and ranking table

This section is the current Figure 6 handoff. It reads only existing RDS and CSV
files and supersedes the instruction immediately above to run the author-15
fit. It does not call `infer_gene_param()`, `infer_cell_phase()`,
`run_phase_rho()` or `run_dtw_similarity()`.

The parameter audit distinguishes the two condition-specific, full-gene,
sample-aware author-cluster fits from the five-gene `param_I` fit. Display
cluster 12 is original author cluster 15, display cluster 1 is original author
cluster 1, display cluster 2 is `s-LNv`, and display cluster 14 is original
author cluster 19 (`DN2`). The five-gene object is listed in the audit but is
not used for any new SRB curve.

Observed-expression figures use saved biological-sample pseudobulk
`log2(CPM + 1)` values and saved descriptive harmonic curves. Their x axis is
labelled `ZT` for a consistent visual display; DD sampling times are CT and
must be described as CT in Methods and the figure legend. SRB figures use the
unshrunk saved parameters directly as
`exp(Mesor + Amplitude * cos(theta - Phase))`. Each gene and author cluster is
exported separately, with LD in green and DD in purple, without a subtitle,
annotation or significance symbol.

The fly ranking table uses the group means already stored in
`rho_sample_summary`, defines delta rho as `mean rho(DD) - mean rho(LD)`, and
extracts the same-cell-type LD-versus-DD raw normalized distance from the saved
DTW `distance` matrix using its `annotation`. Rank 1 is the largest absolute
rho change or largest paired DTW distance; the descriptive combined order is
the ascending sum of those two ranks. P values and BH FDR are retained from
the saved `sig_result` and do not enter the ranking.

```{r figure6-saved-result-review-20261024, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

  "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/GSE157504_validation/GSE157504_existing_results_figures_20261024.R"
)
```
